articles.title: Rebels kill 15 in South Sudan
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: An official hinted at fighters loyal to the country's former first Vice-President Riek Machar, a longtime rival of President Salva Kiir who has been under house arrest since March 2025

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: An attack on Sunday (November 22, 2026) by rebels in northwestern South Sudan has killed at least 15 civilians, with the toll likely to rise, local sources told AFP . One official pointed the finger at fighters loyal to the country's former first Vice-President Riek Machar, a longtime rival of President Salva Kiir who has been under house arrest since March 2025. “The attack on the Bol Bol Boma area in Tonj East County, Warrap State, began late on Saturday,” Machuei Bith, the county's caretaker commissioner, told AFP . He blamed the deaths on fighters from neighbouring Unity State belonging to Machar's SPLA-IO armed group. "Fifteen civilians and cattle keepers were killed and four armed attackers with SPLA-IO uniforms were also killed," he told AFP . A local police officer confirmed the story on condition of anonymity and said the fighting was still ongoing on Sunday morning. "Further details on casualties from both sides will be shared later on with the media," the officer said. 23 dead in clashes between South Sudan government, opposition forces Since independence from Sudan in 2011, the world's youngest country has been forced to grapple with various violent conflicts, linked to political infighting, ethnic tensions or competition for resources.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Between 2013 and 2018, the eastern African country was torn apart by a civil war pitting forces loyal to Machar against those supporting Kiir, which left more than 4,00,000 people dead.

hinglishTracks.en: A local police officer confirmed the story on condition of anonymity and said the fighting was still ongoing on Sunday morning.

hinglishTracks.en: "Further details on casualties from both sides will be shared later on with the media," the officer said.

🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: An official hinted at fighters loyal to the country's former first Vice-President Riek Machar, a longtime rival of President Salva Kiir who has been under house arrest since March 2025

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: An attack on Sunday (November 22, 2026) by rebels in northwestern South Sudan has killed at least 15 civilians, with the toll likely to rise, local sources told AFP . One official pointed the finger at fighters loyal to the country's former first Vice-President Riek Machar, a longtime rival of President Salva Kiir who has been under house arrest since March 2025. “The attack on the Bol Bol Boma area in Tonj East County, Warrap State, began late on Saturday,” Machuei Bith, the county's caretaker commissioner, told AFP . He blamed the deaths on fighters from neighbouring Unity State belonging to Machar's SPLA-IO armed group. "Fifteen civilians and cattle keepers were killed and four armed attackers with SPLA-IO uniforms were also killed," he told AFP . A local police officer confirmed the story on condition of anonymity and said the fighting was still ongoing on Sunday morning. "Further details on casualties from both sides will be shared later on with the media," the officer said. 23 dead in clashes between South Sudan government, opposition forces Since independence from Sudan in 2011, the world's youngest country has been forced to grapple with various violent conflicts, linked to political infighting, ethnic tensions or competition for resources.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Between 2013 and 2018, the eastern African country was torn apart by a civil war pitting forces loyal to Machar against those supporting Kiir, which left more than 4,00,000 people dead.

articles.title: RAPS, a small-town firm that’s now a trusted partner in India’s space and defence missions
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Ramesh’s Aerospace Products & Services Pvt. Ltd., an AS9100-certified MSME, is supplying composite subsystems to about 30 defence and aerospace projects

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: When a multi-million-dollar rocket roars into the sky or a supersonic missile locks onto a target, its survival can hinge on critical components made by companies, all of which are not essentially industry titans. Making these parts requires precision of the highest order, a skill this unassuming company has mastered over the years. Few people may have ever heard about it, as the company quietly operates in the APIIC industrial area at Veerapanenigudem in Gannavaram Mandal of Krishna district, without boasting of its rich accomplishments. The firm is Ramesh’s Aerospace Products & Services Pvt. Ltd. (RAPS) that is supplying to about 30 defence and aerospace projects, in compliance with AS9100, the globally recognised Quality Management System standard that pertains to aviation, space, and defense industries. Rocket firing nozzles being made by Ramesh’s Aerospace Products & Services Pvt. Ltd. at its unit in Veerapanenigudem in Krishna district. | Photo Credit: K.V.S. GIRI This MSME is one of the suppliers of composite subsystems to the DRDO, ISRO, BrahMos and Bharat Dynamics Limited (BDL) projects. RAPS Founder & CEO A. Ramesh Babu told The Hindu that his company makes composite rocket motor casings, thermal insulation systems, missile nozzles, canisters, jet deflectors, re-entry vehicle sections, and lightweight tubes used to launch Man Portable Anti-Tank Guided Missiles. These subsystems are made of advanced materials such as carbon fibre, glass fibre, ROCASIN (a specialised heat-resistant synthetic rubber), Kevlar (a synthetic para aromatic polyamide fibre valued for its high tensile strength-to-weight ratio, impact resistance, thermal stability, and lack of brittleness in cryogenic temperatures), and ablative internal thermal insulators. RAPS is manufacturing and supplying subsystems for various missile programmes covering ranges from 5 km to 5,000 km, and playing an important role in supplying thermal insulation systems for ISRO’s SSLV, PSLV and GSLV launch vehicles.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: An employee of Ramesh’s Aerospace Products & Services Pvt. Ltd. showing a Man Portable Anti-Tank Guided Missile casing made at the company’s manufacturing facility at Veerapanenigudem in Krishna district. | Photo Credit: K.V.S. GIRI

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #8 of 30 (22 NOV)

📰 RAPS, a small-town firm that’s now a trusted partner in India’s space and defence missions

📌 Published: 22 Nov 2026, 07:31:12 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Ramesh’s Aerospace Products & Services Pvt. Ltd., an AS9100-certified MSME, is supplying composite subsystems to about 30 defence and aerospace projects

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: When a multi-million-dollar rocket roars into the sky or a supersonic missile locks onto a target, its survival can hinge on critical components made by companies, all of which are not essentially industry titans. Making these parts requires precision of the highest order, a skill this unassuming company has mastered over the years. Few people may have ever heard about it, as the company quietly operates in the APIIC industrial area at Veerapanenigudem in Gannavaram Mandal of Krishna district, without boasting of its rich accomplishments. The firm is Ramesh’s Aerospace Products & Services Pvt. Ltd. (RAPS) that is supplying to about 30 defence and aerospace projects, in compliance with AS9100, the globally recognised Quality Management System standard that pertains to aviation, space, and defense industries. Rocket firing nozzles being made by Ramesh’s Aerospace Products & Services Pvt. Ltd. at its unit in Veerapanenigudem in Krishna district. | Photo Credit: K.V.S. GIRI This MSME is one of the suppliers of composite subsystems to the DRDO, ISRO, BrahMos and Bharat Dynamics Limited (BDL) projects. RAPS Founder & CEO A. Ramesh Babu told The Hindu that his company makes composite rocket motor casings, thermal insulation systems, missile nozzles, canisters, jet deflectors, re-entry vehicle sections, and lightweight tubes used to launch Man Portable Anti-Tank Guided Missiles. These subsystems are made of advanced materials such as carbon fibre, glass fibre, ROCASIN (a specialised heat-resistant synthetic rubber), Kevlar (a synthetic para aromatic polyamide fibre valued for its high tensile strength-to-weight ratio, impact resistance, thermal stability, and lack of brittleness in cryogenic temperatures), and ablative internal thermal insulators. RAPS is manufacturing and supplying subsystems for various missile programmes covering ranges from 5 km to 5,000 km, and playing an important role in supplying thermal insulation systems for ISRO’s SSLV, PSLV and GSLV launch vehicles.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: An employee of Ramesh’s Aerospace Products & Services Pvt. Ltd. showing a Man Portable Anti-Tank Guided Missile casing made at the company’s manufacturing facility at Veerapanenigudem in Krishna district. | Photo Credit: K.V.S. GIRI

Supersonic (Adjective)
पराध्वनिक — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Supersonic' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Industrial (Adjective)
औद्योगिक — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Industrial' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Compliance (Noun)
अनुपालन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Compliance' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Management (Adjective)
प्रबंध — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Management' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "RAPS, a small-town firm that’s now a trusted partner in India’s space and defence missions", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Ramesh’s Aerospace Products & Services Pvt.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'RAPS, a small-town firm that’s now a trusted par' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'RAPS, a small-town firm that’s now a trusted ' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'RAPS, a small-town firm that’s now a trusted ' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Ramesh’s Aerospace Products & Services Pvt." (Hinglish Arth: रमेश एयरोस्पेस प्रोडक्ट्स एंड सर्विसेज प्रा.)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "RAPS, a small-town firm that’s now a trusted partner in India’s space and defence missions"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. showing a Man Portable Anti-Tank Guided Missile casing made at the company’s manufacturing facility at Veerapanenigudem in Krishna district.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "showing a Man Portable Anti-Tank Guided Missile casing made at the company’s manufacturing facility at Veerapanenigudem in Krishna district." (Hinglish Arth: कृष्णा जिले के वीरापनेनिगुडेम में कंपनी की विनिर्माण सुविधा में बनाई गई एक मैन पोर्टेबल एंटी-टैंक गाइडेड मिसाइल आवरण दिखा रहा है।)

articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: MLA Allamprabhu Patil meets Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar recently and submits a memorandum seeking urgent financial assistance

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: MLA Allamprabhu Patil has urged Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar to release an additional grant of ₹5 crore to address the worsening drinking water crisis in Kalaburagi city where groundwater levels have reportedly depleted in nearly 80% of the areas, while borewells have gone dry. Mr. Patil met the Chief Minister in Bengaluru recently and submitted a memorandum seeking urgent financial assistance to tackle the situation. In the memorandum, the MLA also drew the Chief Minister’s attention to the extensive crop losses in the district due to drought and sought the early release of interim crop insurance compensation to farmers who have enrolled under the crop insurance scheme and paid their premiums. He urged the Chief Minister to expedite the disbursement of drought relief to farmers. Referring to the State government’s announcement of a minimum input subsidy of ₹5,000 to drought-affected farmers, he said that the first instalment of ₹2,500 has already been initiated through direct benefit transfer (DBT) to farmers bank accounts. He requested the State government to ensure that the amount reaches all eligible farmers without delay and that the remaining amount is also released at the earliest. Mr. Patil also urged the Chief Minister to take up with the Maharashtra Government the issue of Karnataka’s share of water from the Ujani reservoir and get water released into the Bhima river course. He said that Maharashtra has failed to release Karnataka’s allocated share of 15 tmcft of water from the reservoir. Pointing out that the region is facing severe drought, he said that the Ujani reservoir reportedly holds around 60 tmcft of water in its dead storage.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: He urged Mr. Shivakumar to initiate discussions with the Maharashtra government and secure the release of at least 2 tmcft of water into the Bhima river course as an immediate measure.

hinglishTracks.en: He urged the Chief Minister to expedite the disbursement of drought relief to farmers.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — उन्होंने मुख्यमंत्री से किसानों को सूखा राहत वितरण में तेजी लाने का आग्रह किया।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Disbursement' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: अदायगी — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Disbursement' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: Referring to the State government’s announcement of a minimum input subsidy of ₹5,000 to drought-affected farmers, he said that the first instalment of ₹2,500 has already been initiated through direct benefit transfer (DBT) to farmers bank accounts.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — सूखा प्रभावित किसानों को न्यूनतम 5,000 रुपये की इनपुट सब्सिडी की राज्य सरकार की घोषणा का जिक्र करते हुए उन्होंने कहा कि किसानों के बैंक खातों में प्रत्यक्ष लाभ हस्तांतरण (डीबीटी) के माध्यम से 2,500 रुपये की पहली किस्त पहले ही शुरू की जा चुकी है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Accountability' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता। इसके Synonyms हैं: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability और Antonyms हैं: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility।

hinglishTracks.en: He requested the State government to ensure that the amount reaches all eligible farmers without delay and that the remaining amount is also released at the earliest.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — उन्होंने राज्य सरकार से यह सुनिश्चित करने का अनुरोध किया कि राशि बिना किसी देरी के सभी पात्र किसानों तक पहुंचे और शेष राशि भी जल्द से जल्द जारी की जाए।।

hinglishTracks.en: Patil also urged the Chief Minister to take up with the Maharashtra Government the issue of Karnataka’s share of water from the Ujani reservoir and get water released into the Bhima river course.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — पाटिल ने मुख्यमंत्री से उजानी जलाशय से कर्नाटक के हिस्से के पानी का मुद्दा महाराष्ट्र सरकार के समक्ष उठाने और भीमा नदी मार्ग में पानी छोड़े जाने का भी आग्रह किया।।

hinglishTracks.en: He said that Maharashtra has failed to release Karnataka’s allocated share of 15 tmcft of water from the reservoir.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — उन्होंने कहा कि महाराष्ट्र जलाशय से कर्नाटक के आवंटित हिस्से का 15 टीएमसीएफटी पानी जारी करने में विफल रहा है।।

• 1. Core Context & Background: MLA Allamprabhu Patil meets Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar recently and submits a memorandum seeking urgent financial assistance
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: MLA Allamprabhu Patil has urged Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar to release an additional grant of ₹5 crore to address the worsening drinking water crisis in Kalaburagi city where groundwater levels have reportedly depleted in nearly 80% of the areas, while borewells have gone dry. Mr. Patil met the Chief Minister in Bengaluru recently and submitted a memorandum seeking urgent financial assistance to tackle the situation. In the memorandum, the MLA also drew the Chief Minister’s attention to the extensive crop losses in the district due to drought and sought the early release of interim crop insurance compensation to farmers who have enrolled under the crop insurance scheme and paid their premiums. He urged the Chief Minister to expedite the disbursement of drought relief to farmers. Referring to the State government’s announcement of a minimum input subsidy of ₹5,000 to drought-affected farmers, he said that the first instalment of ₹2,500 has already been initiated through direct benefit transfer (DBT) to farmers bank accounts. He requested the State government to ensure that the amount reaches all eligible farmers without delay and that the remaining amount is also released at the earliest. Mr. Patil also urged the Chief Minister to take up with the Maharashtra Government the issue of Karnataka’s share of water from the Ujani reservoir and get water released into the Bhima river course. He said that Maharashtra has failed to release Karnataka’s allocated share of 15 tmcft of water from the reservoir. Pointing out that the region is facing severe drought, he said that the Ujani reservoir reportedly holds around 60 tmcft of water in its dead storage.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: He urged Mr. Shivakumar to initiate discussions with the Maharashtra government and secure the release of at least 2 tmcft of water into the Bhima river course as an immediate measure.

articles.title: COP31 fails to agree on climate deal in chaotic finale
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: ‘I understand that there is no agreement on this text. For that reason, these decisions have not been adopted,’ COP31 President Murat Kurum told the closing session

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The COP31 climate talks headed for a historic defeat on Sunday (November 22, 2026) after the EU and other countries refused to endorse a pact that omitted fossil fuels as the summit lurched into record overtime in Turkey. The main deal was rejected by a host of nations 44 hours after the summit's official close in a chaotic COP31 finale in the Turkish city of Antalya. "We will not endorse a cover decision... that does not even mention fossil fuels, which is the key driver of climate change," said Ireland's Climate Minister, Darragh O'Brien, whose country holds the rotating EU Presidency. COP31 President Murat Kurum conceded the deal had failed to reach consensus. "I understand that there is no agreement on this text. For that reason, these decisions have not been adopted," he told the closing session. Fossil fuels are a flashpoint at the climate talks, which come against a difficult backdrop of soaring energy prices and geopolitical tensions stemming from the war between the United States and Iran that has roiled the West Asia. Language around fossil fuels is fiercely opposed by petrostates such as Saudi Arabia. With expectations low, negotiations chief Australia had sought an overarching "cover decision" to capture what countries agreed at COP31 and send a signal about the future course of climate action. But the final proposal failed to mention coal, oil, and gas at all, plunging the summit into turmoil as it broke the record for the longest-ever UN climate conference.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: "We will not compromise our future to benefit fossil fuel interests. We will not accept an outcome that undermines our security and threatens our future," the Marshall Islands climate envoy Kathy Jetnil-Kijiner told delegates.

But the final proposal failed to mention coal, oil, and gas at all, plunging the summit into turmoil as it broke the record for the longest-ever UN climate conference.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: "We will not compromise our future to benefit fossil fuel interests. We will not accept an outcome that undermines our security and threatens our future," the Marshall Islands climate envoy Kathy Jetnil-Kijiner told delegates.

articles.title: Woman delivers triplets after non-ART treatment at Telangana govt. hospital; premature babies discharged after NICU care
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: After a nine-year wait and unsuccessful fertility treatment at private hospitals, a couple welcomed triplet boys following treatment at Gandhi Hospital’s IVF Centre. The premature babies, who weighed between 1.4 kg and 1.5 kg at birth, spent over a month in the hospital’s Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU). They were discharged along with their 32-year-old mother after responding well to treatment.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Avanthi enrolled at Gandhi Hospital’s IVF Centre in January this year. Doctors opted for ovulation induction, a non-assisted reproductive treatment, and she conceived in the second cycle. After scans revealed a triplet pregnancy and a short cervix, doctors performed a McDonald’s cervical cerclage at 14 weeks. However, her water broke prematurely at 32 weeks, prompting doctors to deliver the babies on October 7. The newborns were admitted to the NICU, where they received treatment and close monitoring for over a month before being discharged with their mother. Director of Medical Education Vanii appreciated the efforts of the team, including head of the Department of Gynaecology Shobha, IVF specialists Krishnaveni and Fathima Rafi, embryologist Shiva Krishna, lab technician Ashok and counsellor Kavitha.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: IVF specialist Dr Krishnaveni said that they opted ovulation induction as a first line of treatment, which is not a In Vitro Fertilization (IVF) method. “We conduct evaluations to know if non-IVF methods can be used as first line of treatment to avoid burden on couples who are already in distress,” she said. Currently, over 500 couples have rolled for treatments at the government hospitals IVF centre.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #7 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Woman delivers triplets after non-ART treatment at Telangana govt. hospital; premature babies discharged after NICU care

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 01:20:03 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: After a nine-year wait and unsuccessful fertility treatment at private hospitals, a couple welcomed triplet boys following treatment at Gandhi Hospital’s IVF Centre. The premature babies, who weighed between 1.4 kg and 1.5 kg at birth, spent over a month in the hospital’s Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU). They were discharged along with their 32-year-old mother after responding well to treatment.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Avanthi enrolled at Gandhi Hospital’s IVF Centre in January this year. Doctors opted for ovulation induction, a non-assisted reproductive treatment, and she conceived in the second cycle. After scans revealed a triplet pregnancy and a short cervix, doctors performed a McDonald’s cervical cerclage at 14 weeks. However, her water broke prematurely at 32 weeks, prompting doctors to deliver the babies on October 7. The newborns were admitted to the NICU, where they received treatment and close monitoring for over a month before being discharged with their mother. Director of Medical Education Vanii appreciated the efforts of the team, including head of the Department of Gynaecology Shobha, IVF specialists Krishnaveni and Fathima Rafi, embryologist Shiva Krishna, lab technician Ashok and counsellor Kavitha.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: IVF specialist Dr Krishnaveni said that they opted ovulation induction as a first line of treatment, which is not a In Vitro Fertilization (IVF) method. “We conduct evaluations to know if non-IVF methods can be used as first line of treatment to avoid burden on couples who are already in distress,” she said. Currently, over 500 couples have rolled for treatments at the government hospitals IVF centre.

✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Department (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Department' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Treatment (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Treatment' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Woman delivers triplets after non-ART treatment at Telangana govt. hospital; premature babies discharged after NICU care", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. After a nine-year wait and unsuccessful fertility treatment at private hospitals, a couple welcomed triplet boys following treatment at Gandhi...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Woman delivers triplets after non-ART treatment ' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Woman delivers triplets after non-ART treatme' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Woman delivers triplets after non-ART treatme' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "After a nine-year wait and unsuccessful fertility treatment at private hospitals, a couple welcomed triplet boys following treatment at Gandhi..." (Hinglish Arth: नौ साल के इंतजार और निजी अस्पतालों में असफल प्रजनन उपचार के बाद, एक जोड़े ने गांधी अस्पताल के आईवीएफ केंद्र में इलाज के बाद तीन बेटों का स्वागत किया।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Woman delivers triplets after non-ART treatment at Telangana govt. hospital; premature babies discharged after NICU care"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Currently, over 500 couples have rolled for treatments at the government hospitals IVF centre.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Currently, over 500 couples have rolled for treatments at the government hospitals IVF centre." (Hinglish Arth: वर्तमान में, 500 से अधिक जोड़े सरकारी अस्पतालों के आईवीएफ केंद्र में इलाज के लिए आए हैं।)

articles.title: IJCCI to lead business delegation to Japan from Nov. 30
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The Indo-Japan Chamber of Commerce and Industry (IJCCI) organised a business networking meeting with a 16-member business delegation from Osaka, Japan, to strengthen bilateral business ties and explore opportunities for trade, investment, and industrial collaboration between India and Japan.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The delegation was led by Hiromitsu Morishima, Chairperson, International Business Committee, Osaka Chamber of Commerce and Industry, and Yasushi Ninomiya, Director-General, JETRO Osaka. The companies spoke about their products and business opportunities. To strengthen bilateral economic relations, IJCCI is leading a 16-member delegation to Japan from November 30 to December 4. The delegation will visit Tokyo, Yokohama, Kochi, Fukuoka, Hiroshima, and Osaka. “We particularly look forward to strengthening our engagement with Osaka, which is one of Japan’s leading commercial and industrial centres,” said IJCCI president S. Padmanabhan. “India, with its large domestic market, growing manufacturing capabilities, and developing digital economy, offers significant opportunities for Japanese businesses,” Mr. Padmanabhan added.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: He further said that Indian companies can benefit from Japanese technology, management practices, and innovation.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #8 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 IJCCI to lead business delegation to Japan from Nov. 30

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 01:19:59 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The Indo-Japan Chamber of Commerce and Industry (IJCCI) organised a business networking meeting with a 16-member business delegation from Osaka, Japan, to strengthen bilateral business ties and explore opportunities for trade, investment, and industrial collaboration between India and Japan.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The delegation was led by Hiromitsu Morishima, Chairperson, International Business Committee, Osaka Chamber of Commerce and Industry, and Yasushi Ninomiya, Director-General, JETRO Osaka. The companies spoke about their products and business opportunities. To strengthen bilateral economic relations, IJCCI is leading a 16-member delegation to Japan from November 30 to December 4. The delegation will visit Tokyo, Yokohama, Kochi, Fukuoka, Hiroshima, and Osaka. “We particularly look forward to strengthening our engagement with Osaka, which is one of Japan’s leading commercial and industrial centres,” said IJCCI president S. Padmanabhan. “India, with its large domestic market, growing manufacturing capabilities, and developing digital economy, offers significant opportunities for Japanese businesses,” Mr. Padmanabhan added.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: He further said that Indian companies can benefit from Japanese technology, management practices, and innovation.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Bilateral (Adjective)
द्विपक्षीय — दो देशों के बीच आपसी समझौता, व्यापार या कूटनीतिक बातचीत।
✓ Syn: Reciprocal, Two-sided, Mutual  |  ✖ Ant: Unilateral, Multilateral, One-way
Collaboration (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Collaboration' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
International (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'International' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Delegation (Adjective / Verb)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Delegation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "IJCCI to lead business delegation to Japan from Nov. 30", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. The Indo-Japan Chamber of Commerce and Industry (IJCCI) organised a business networking meeting with a 16-member business delegation from Osaka,...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'IJCCI to lead business delegation to Japan from ' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'IJCCI to lead business delegation to Japan fr' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'IJCCI to lead business delegation to Japan fr' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "The Indo-Japan Chamber of Commerce and Industry (IJCCI) organised a business networking meeting with a 16-member business delegation from Osaka,..." (Hinglish Arth: इंडो-जापान चैंबर ऑफ कॉमर्स एंड इंडस्ट्री (आईजेसीसीआई) ने द्विपक्षीय व्यापार संबंधों को मजबूत करने और अवसरों का पता लगाने के लिए ओसाका, जापान के 16 सदस्यीय व्यापार प्रतिनिधिमंडल के साथ एक व्यापार नेटवर्किंग बैठक का आयोजन किया।)

A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. He further said that Indian companies can benefit from Japanese technology, management practices, and innovation.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "He further said that Indian companies can benefit from Japanese technology, management practices, and innovation." (Hinglish Arth: उन्होंने आगे कहा कि भारतीय कंपनियां जापानी प्रौद्योगिकी, प्रबंधन प्रथाओं और नवाचार से लाभ उठा सकती हैं।)

articles.title: Infra push and low base effect pushes core sector growth to series-high of 10.9% in October 2026
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-III & IBPS/SBI/RBI/SSC: RBI Monetary Policy, GDP Growth, Inflation, Fiscal Deficit & Trade Balance
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: While the coal and electricity sectors saw growth shoot up, a large part of this was due to a statistical effect rather than growth in actual output. On the other hand, fuel-related sectors contracted again

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Growth in the core industrial sectors of the economy climbed to a series-high of 10.9% in October 2026, driven by a surge in electricity generation, and coal, cement, and iron ore production, and a low base effect, official data released on Friday (November 20, 2026) showed. Data released by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry on the Index of Core Industries shows that growth in October surpassed the 8.2% in September, the previous series high. The new index, released this year with a base year of 2022-23, has data that goes back only up to April 2024. However, the data also shows that the strong growth figure in October was also likely aided by the fact that the index grew a relatively poor 0.8% in October last year. “While core output surged by 10.9% in October 2026, the fastest pace in the new series, this was supported by a low base related to the shift in the festive calendar, with output having expanded by a marginal 0.8% in the year ago month,” Aditi Nayar, chief economist at ICRA said. “While the growth print for October 2026 signals a strong start for the third quarter of FY2027, this is largely optical,” Ms. Nayar added. “The average performance for October-November 2026 would provide a better assessment, as this would adjust for festive base effects.” Within the index, the coal sector saw growth accelerating to 23.05% in October 2026, far faster than the 10.7% registered in September. October’s performance, however, is likely also due to low base effect, since the sector contracted 8.4% in October last year. The growth in the index, however, is in line with what the industry itself has reported. Coal India, the country’s largest coal company, reported that production increased about 19% to 67.2 million tonnes (MT) in October. A major reason for the growth in coal production was likely demand from the power sector, which saw electricity generation jump by 21.6% in October 2026, up from 12.6% in the previous month. However, this sector too could have benefited from a low base effect, since it contracted nearly 7% in October 2025. Within the index, the infrastructure-related sectors were the only ones that grew strongly without the aid of a statistical low base effect.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The iron ore sector, for example, grew at a three-month high of 23.4% in October 2026, compared to 18.4% in September and 8.7% in October last year. One of the factors driving this strong growth was that steel production grew at 7.3% in October, the fastest rate in seven months.

📈 Economic, Banking & Finance Paragraph #15 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Infra push and low base effect pushes core sector growth to series-high of 10.9% in October 2026

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 01:18:11 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: While the coal and electricity sectors saw growth shoot up, a large part of this was due to a statistical effect rather than growth in actual output. On the other hand, fuel-related sectors contracted again

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Growth in the core industrial sectors of the economy climbed to a series-high of 10.9% in October 2026, driven by a surge in electricity generation, and coal, cement, and iron ore production, and a low base effect, official data released on Friday (November 20, 2026) showed. Data released by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry on the Index of Core Industries shows that growth in October surpassed the 8.2% in September, the previous series high. The new index, released this year with a base year of 2022-23, has data that goes back only up to April 2024. However, the data also shows that the strong growth figure in October was also likely aided by the fact that the index grew a relatively poor 0.8% in October last year. “While core output surged by 10.9% in October 2026, the fastest pace in the new series, this was supported by a low base related to the shift in the festive calendar, with output having expanded by a marginal 0.8% in the year ago month,” Aditi Nayar, chief economist at ICRA said. “While the growth print for October 2026 signals a strong start for the third quarter of FY2027, this is largely optical,” Ms. Nayar added. “The average performance for October-November 2026 would provide a better assessment, as this would adjust for festive base effects.” Within the index, the coal sector saw growth accelerating to 23.05% in October 2026, far faster than the 10.7% registered in September. October’s performance, however, is likely also due to low base effect, since the sector contracted 8.4% in October last year. The growth in the index, however, is in line with what the industry itself has reported. Coal India, the country’s largest coal company, reported that production increased about 19% to 67.2 million tonnes (MT) in October. A major reason for the growth in coal production was likely demand from the power sector, which saw electricity generation jump by 21.6% in October 2026, up from 12.6% in the previous month. However, this sector too could have benefited from a low base effect, since it contracted nearly 7% in October 2025. Within the index, the infrastructure-related sectors were the only ones that grew strongly without the aid of a statistical low base effect.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The iron ore sector, for example, grew at a three-month high of 23.4% in October 2026, compared to 18.4% in September and 8.7% in October last year. One of the factors driving this strong growth was that steel production grew at 7.3% in October, the fastest rate in seven months.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Electricity (Noun)
बिजली — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Electricity' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Statistical (Adjective)
सांख्यिकीय — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Statistical' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Performance (Noun)
प्रदर्शन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Performance' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Industrial (Adjective)
औद्योगिक — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Industrial' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 📈 Economic, Banking & Finance passage on "Infra push and low base effect pushes core sector growth to series-high of 10.9% in October 2026", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. While the coal and electricity sectors saw growth shoot up, a large part of this was due to a statistical effect rather than growth in actual output.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Infra push and low base effect pushes core secto' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Infra push and low base effect pushes core se' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Infra push and low base effect pushes core se' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "While the coal and electricity sectors saw growth shoot up, a large part of this was due to a statistical effect rather than growth in actual output." (Hinglish Arth: जबकि कोयला और बिजली क्षेत्रों में वृद्धि देखी गई, इसका एक बड़ा हिस्सा वास्तविक उत्पादन में वृद्धि के बजाय सांख्यिकीय प्रभाव के कारण था।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Infra push and low base effect pushes core sector growth to series-high of 10.9% in October 2026"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. One of the factors driving this strong growth was that steel production grew at 7.3% in October, the fastest rate in seven months.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "One of the factors driving this strong growth was that steel production grew at 7.3% in October, the fastest rate in seven months." (Hinglish Arth: इस मजबूत वृद्धि को चलाने वाले कारकों में से एक यह था कि अक्टूबर में इस्पात उत्पादन 7.3% की दर से बढ़ा, जो सात महीनों में सबसे तेज़ दर थी।)

articles.title: Following Cyclone Akvan, monsoon rain to resume over T.N. from tomorrow
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The RMC has forecast moderate rainfall in coastal districts, including Chennai and Cuddalore, and mild rainfall over adjoining areas; wet weather likely to last till the first week of December

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Following Cyclone Akvan’s passage on Friday morning, most parts of Tamil Nadu are likely to experience a brief break in monsoon activity, accompanied by a dip in night-time temperatures. Wet weather is expected to return on Sunday and intensify over the subsequent days. The break in rainfall is expected to raise day temperatures by two or three degrees Celsius in a few pockets of the State. The Regional Meteorological Centre (RMC) has also forecast ground frost at isolated places in the Nilgiris and Kodaikanal till Sunday. The absence of widespread rainfall has pushed various districts, including Tiruvarur, Thanjavur, Madurai, Salem, and Chengalpattu, into the rainfall deficit category. The State has so far received nearly 26 cm of monsoon rainfall, which is 14% lower than its seasonal share since October 1. RMC officials said Cyclone Akvan was expected to weaken into a depression on Friday, and gradually fade away. V.R. Durai, Head, Regional Weather Forecasting Centre, RMC, said dry and cold northwesterly winds and the absence of cloud cover and rainfall led to a rise in day temperatures and drop in minimum temperatures over most parts of the State. A trough in the easterly wave is likely to revive rainfall activity from Sunday and bring intense rainfall from Monday as it moves across the State. While coastal districts are expected to benefit more, interior Tamil Nadu is also likely to receive moderate rainfall till November 26. “We are expecting wet weather in the State till December first week, with a low pressure area likely to form then. The sustained rainfall activity may narrow rainfall deficit,” he said. The RMC has forecast moderate rainfall over coastal districts, including Chennai, Cuddalore, and Nagapattinam, on Sunday and mild rainfall over areas adjoining coastal districts.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: On Monday, rainfall is expected to intensify over 10 coastal districts, including Cuddalore, Thoothukudi, and Kanniyakumari.

hinglishTracks.en: The RMC has forecast moderate rainfall in coastal districts, including Chennai and Cuddalore, and mild rainfall over adjoining areas; wet weather likely to last till the first week of December
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — आरएमसी ने चेन्नई और कुड्डालोर सहित तटीय जिलों में मध्यम वर्षा और आसपास के क्षेत्रों में हल्की वर्षा का अनुमान लगाया है; गीला मौसम दिसंबर के पहले सप्ताह तक रहने की संभावना है।

hinglishTracks.en: Following Cyclone Akvan’s passage on Friday morning, most parts of Tamil Nadu are likely to experience a brief break in monsoon activity, accompanied by a dip in night-time temperatures.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — शुक्रवार की सुबह चक्रवात अकवन के गुजरने के बाद, तमिलनाडु के अधिकांश हिस्सों में रात के समय के तापमान में गिरावट के साथ, मानसून गतिविधि में एक संक्षिप्त विराम का अनुभव होने की संभावना है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Experience' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Experience' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — बारिश में रुकावट से राज्य के कुछ इलाकों में दिन का तापमान दो या तीन डिग्री सेल्सियस बढ़ने की उम्मीद है।।

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — क्षेत्रीय मौसम विज्ञान केंद्र (आरएमसी) ने भी रविवार तक नीलगिरी और कोडाइकनाल में अलग-अलग स्थानों पर बर्फ जमने की भविष्यवाणी की है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Meteorological' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: मौसम विज्ञान और वायुमंडलीय परिवर्तनों से संबंधित (Connected with weather forecasting and atmospheric shifts). इसके Synonyms हैं: Atmospheric, Climatic, Weather-related और Antonyms हैं: Geological, Subterranean, Terrestrial।

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — व्यापक वर्षा की अनुपस्थिति ने तिरुवरुर, तंजावुर, मदुरै, सेलम और चेंगलपट्टू सहित विभिन्न जिलों को वर्षा की कमी की श्रेणी में धकेल दिया है।।

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — राज्य में अब तक लगभग 26 सेमी मानसूनी वर्षा हुई है, जो 1 अक्टूबर के बाद से इसके मौसमी हिस्से से 14% कम है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Durai, Head, Regional Weather Forecasting Centre, RMC, said dry and cold northwesterly winds and the absence of cloud cover and rainfall led to a rise in day temperatures and drop in minimum temperatures over most parts of the State.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — आरएमसी के क्षेत्रीय मौसम पूर्वानुमान केंद्र के प्रमुख दुरई ने कहा कि शुष्क और ठंडी उत्तर-पश्चिमी हवाएं और बादल और बारिश की अनुपस्थिति के कारण राज्य के अधिकांश हिस्सों में दिन के तापमान में वृद्धि हुई और न्यूनतम तापमान में गिरावट आई।।

hinglishTracks.en: A trough in the easterly wave is likely to revive rainfall activity from Sunday and bring intense rainfall from Monday as it moves across the State.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — पूर्वी लहर में एक ट्रफ रेखा के रविवार से वर्षा गतिविधि फिर से शुरू होने और सोमवार से तीव्र वर्षा होने की संभावना है क्योंकि यह पूरे राज्य में आगे बढ़ेगी।।

hinglishTracks.en: While coastal districts are expected to benefit more, interior Tamil Nadu is also likely to receive moderate rainfall till November 26.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — जबकि तटीय जिलों को अधिक लाभ होने की उम्मीद है, आंतरिक तमिलनाडु में भी 26 नवंबर तक मध्यम वर्षा होने की संभावना है।।

hinglishTracks.en: “We are expecting wet weather in the State till December first week, with a low pressure area likely to form then.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — “हम दिसंबर के पहले सप्ताह तक राज्य में गीले मौसम की उम्मीद कर रहे हैं, उसके बाद कम दबाव का क्षेत्र बनने की संभावना है।।

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Following Cyclone Akvan, monsoon rain to resume over T.N. from tomorrow

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 01:16:09 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The RMC has forecast moderate rainfall in coastal districts, including Chennai and Cuddalore, and mild rainfall over adjoining areas; wet weather likely to last till the first week of December

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Following Cyclone Akvan’s passage on Friday morning, most parts of Tamil Nadu are likely to experience a brief break in monsoon activity, accompanied by a dip in night-time temperatures. Wet weather is expected to return on Sunday and intensify over the subsequent days. The break in rainfall is expected to raise day temperatures by two or three degrees Celsius in a few pockets of the State. The Regional Meteorological Centre (RMC) has also forecast ground frost at isolated places in the Nilgiris and Kodaikanal till Sunday. The absence of widespread rainfall has pushed various districts, including Tiruvarur, Thanjavur, Madurai, Salem, and Chengalpattu, into the rainfall deficit category. The State has so far received nearly 26 cm of monsoon rainfall, which is 14% lower than its seasonal share since October 1. RMC officials said Cyclone Akvan was expected to weaken into a depression on Friday, and gradually fade away. V.R. Durai, Head, Regional Weather Forecasting Centre, RMC, said dry and cold northwesterly winds and the absence of cloud cover and rainfall led to a rise in day temperatures and drop in minimum temperatures over most parts of the State. A trough in the easterly wave is likely to revive rainfall activity from Sunday and bring intense rainfall from Monday as it moves across the State. While coastal districts are expected to benefit more, interior Tamil Nadu is also likely to receive moderate rainfall till November 26. “We are expecting wet weather in the State till December first week, with a low pressure area likely to form then. The sustained rainfall activity may narrow rainfall deficit,” he said. The RMC has forecast moderate rainfall over coastal districts, including Chennai, Cuddalore, and Nagapattinam, on Sunday and mild rainfall over areas adjoining coastal districts.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: On Monday, rainfall is expected to intensify over 10 coastal districts, including Cuddalore, Thoothukudi, and Kanniyakumari.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Meteorological (Adjective)
मौसम विज्ञान और वायुमंडलीय परिवर्तनों से संबंधित (Connected with weather forecasting and atmospheric shifts).
✓ Syn: Atmospheric, Climatic, Weather-related  |  ✖ Ant: Geological, Subterranean, Terrestrial
Sustainability (Noun)
सतत विकास — पर्यावरण और भविष्य की पीढ़ियों को नुकसान पहुँचाए बिना लंबे समय तक चलने वाला विकास।
✓ Syn: Viability, Eco-balance, Durability  |  ✖ Ant: Depletion, Unsustainability, Destruction
Experience (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Experience' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Kodaikanal (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Kodaikanal' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Following Cyclone Akvan, monsoon rain to resume over T.N. from tomorrow", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. The RMC has forecast moderate rainfall in coastal districts, including Chennai and Cuddalore, and mild rainfall over adjoining areas; wet weather...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Following Cyclone Akvan, monsoon rain to resume ' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Following Cyclone Akvan, monsoon rain to resu' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Following Cyclone Akvan, monsoon rain to resu' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "The RMC has forecast moderate rainfall in coastal districts, including Chennai and Cuddalore, and mild rainfall over adjoining areas; wet weather..." (Hinglish Arth: आरएमसी ने चेन्नई और कुड्डालोर सहित तटीय जिलों में मध्यम वर्षा और आसपास के क्षेत्रों में हल्की वर्षा का अनुमान लगाया है; गीला मौसम दिसंबर के पहले सप्ताह तक रहने की संभावना है)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Following Cyclone Akvan, monsoon rain to resume over T.N. from tomorrow"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. On Monday, rainfall is expected to intensify over 10 coastal districts, including Cuddalore, Thoothukudi, and Kanniyakumari.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "On Monday, rainfall is expected to intensify over 10 coastal districts, including Cuddalore, Thoothukudi, and Kanniyakumari." (Hinglish Arth: सोमवार को कुड्डालोर, थूथुकुडी और कन्नियाकुमारी सहित 10 तटीय जिलों में बारिश तेज होने की उम्मीद है।)

articles.title: Lawyer seeks to probate will left behind by former DGP’s wife: Madras High Court orders CB-CID probe after suspecting its genuineness
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Justices N. Sathish Kumar and G.K. Muthukumaar direct incumbent DGP Mahesh Kumar Aggarwal to ensure that an investigation gets conducted after registering a FIR

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Madras High Court has ordered a Crime Branch-Criminal Investigation Department (CB-CID) probe into a claim made by a lawyer that former Director General of Police K. Ravindran’s wife Rani Ravindran alias Rani Pushpalatha Ravindran had appointed him as the executor of a will left behind by her bequeathing all her valuable properties in Chennai and New Delhi to her personal assistant. A Division Bench of Justices N. Sathish Kumar and G.K. Muthukumaar directed the incumbent Director General of Police/Head of Police Force (DGP/HoPF) Mahesh Kumar Aggarwal to ensure that the CB-CID registers a First Information Report (FIR) regarding the claim made by advocate E. Paramasivan, conducts an investigation and files a status report before the court by December 14, 2026. The judges asked Additional Public Prosecutor M. Mohamed Riyaz to convey their order to the DGP/HoPF forthwith so that the investigation could commence as early as possible. “Prima facie, we are satisfied that this is nothing but a clear case of land grabbing by the lawyers, particularly against elderly persons whose legal heirs are not residing in the city,” the judges wrote. Advocate C.K. Chandrasekar, representing the Administrator General and Official Trustee (AG&OT) of Tamil Nadu told the court that the deceased woman’s grandson was living in Australia but that fact had been suppressed in a petition filed before a single judge of the High Court last year seeking probate of a supposed will. The Bench directed the AG&OT to take possession of all properties and communicate it to the legal heirs. The directions were issued on an appeal preferred by Mr. Paramasivan against the refusal of Justice A.D. Maria Clete to grant probate after suspecting the genuineness of the supposed will. The judge had taken note that the former DGP had died in 2021 and his wife had passed away in Chennai on May 2, 2025. Mr. Paramasivan had approached the court claiming that the couple were issueless. He also claimed that the deceased woman had executed a will bequeathing all her properties in the name of her caretaker S. Dilip Kumar and had appointed the petitioner as the executor of the will. However, Justice Clete found that the undated will did not contain the testatrix’s signature but only a thumb impression on each page and no other document was produced in court to compare the thumb impressions. Though the petitioner had claimed to be the deceased woman’s lawyer for about 10 years, he had failed to produce any material to prove the claimed professional relationship. “On the contrary, he admitted that the testatrix had no litigation pending before any court in Chennai and that he had never represented her in any legal proceedings,” the judge highlighted. “In the absence of any evidence regarding the nature of the legal services rendered by the petitioner, it remains unexplained how he came to be appointed as the sole executor under the will. Ordinarily, the appointment of an executor reflects a relationship of confidence, trust, or close association between the testator and the executor,” the judge said. She was also not convinced with the explanation given by Mr. Paramasivan for the existence of the words ‘Drafted by Self’ on the last page of the will though he claimed to have drafted the document. The lawyer said, those words were included because the Registration department always insists such a mention in a will before accepting it for registration.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “The above explanation is unconvincing. There is no legal provision or established practice that prohibits an advocate or a licensed document writer from mentioning their name in a will they have drafted. On the contrary, it is common for the scribe of a will, whether an advocate or a document writer, to disclose their identity and sign the document,” the judge said.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Lawyer seeks to probate will left behind by former DGP’s wife: Madras High Court orders CB-CID probe after suspecting its genuineness

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 01:14:48 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Justices N. Sathish Kumar and G.K. Muthukumaar direct incumbent DGP Mahesh Kumar Aggarwal to ensure that an investigation gets conducted after registering a FIR

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Madras High Court has ordered a Crime Branch-Criminal Investigation Department (CB-CID) probe into a claim made by a lawyer that former Director General of Police K. Ravindran’s wife Rani Ravindran alias Rani Pushpalatha Ravindran had appointed him as the executor of a will left behind by her bequeathing all her valuable properties in Chennai and New Delhi to her personal assistant. A Division Bench of Justices N. Sathish Kumar and G.K. Muthukumaar directed the incumbent Director General of Police/Head of Police Force (DGP/HoPF) Mahesh Kumar Aggarwal to ensure that the CB-CID registers a First Information Report (FIR) regarding the claim made by advocate E. Paramasivan, conducts an investigation and files a status report before the court by December 14, 2026. The judges asked Additional Public Prosecutor M. Mohamed Riyaz to convey their order to the DGP/HoPF forthwith so that the investigation could commence as early as possible. “Prima facie, we are satisfied that this is nothing but a clear case of land grabbing by the lawyers, particularly against elderly persons whose legal heirs are not residing in the city,” the judges wrote. Advocate C.K. Chandrasekar, representing the Administrator General and Official Trustee (AG&OT) of Tamil Nadu told the court that the deceased woman’s grandson was living in Australia but that fact had been suppressed in a petition filed before a single judge of the High Court last year seeking probate of a supposed will. The Bench directed the AG&OT to take possession of all properties and communicate it to the legal heirs. The directions were issued on an appeal preferred by Mr. Paramasivan against the refusal of Justice A.D. Maria Clete to grant probate after suspecting the genuineness of the supposed will. The judge had taken note that the former DGP had died in 2021 and his wife had passed away in Chennai on May 2, 2025. Mr. Paramasivan had approached the court claiming that the couple were issueless. He also claimed that the deceased woman had executed a will bequeathing all her properties in the name of her caretaker S. Dilip Kumar and had appointed the petitioner as the executor of the will. However, Justice Clete found that the undated will did not contain the testatrix’s signature but only a thumb impression on each page and no other document was produced in court to compare the thumb impressions. Though the petitioner had claimed to be the deceased woman’s lawyer for about 10 years, he had failed to produce any material to prove the claimed professional relationship. “On the contrary, he admitted that the testatrix had no litigation pending before any court in Chennai and that he had never represented her in any legal proceedings,” the judge highlighted. “In the absence of any evidence regarding the nature of the legal services rendered by the petitioner, it remains unexplained how he came to be appointed as the sole executor under the will. Ordinarily, the appointment of an executor reflects a relationship of confidence, trust, or close association between the testator and the executor,” the judge said. She was also not convinced with the explanation given by Mr. Paramasivan for the existence of the words ‘Drafted by Self’ on the last page of the will though he claimed to have drafted the document. The lawyer said, those words were included because the Registration department always insists such a mention in a will before accepting it for registration.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “The above explanation is unconvincing. There is no legal provision or established practice that prohibits an advocate or a licensed document writer from mentioning their name in a will they have drafted. On the contrary, it is common for the scribe of a will, whether an advocate or a document writer, to disclose their identity and sign the document,” the judge said.

✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Registration' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: First proposed by German mathematician Bernhard Riemann in 1859, the hypothesis concerns the distribution of prime numbers and is widely regarded as the most important open question in pure mathematics

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A mathematician at AI company Anthropic said Friday (November 20, 2026) that he had used the firm’s Claude chatbot to prove the Riemann Hypothesis, a problem that has eluded mathematicians for more than 160 years. “I believe I have, working with Claude, discovered proof of the Riemann Hypothesis,” Levent Alpoge wrote in a four-page note released Friday (November 20, 2026). The claim has not been independently verified, and the proof has not yet been reviewed by outside experts. First proposed by German mathematician Bernhard Riemann in 1859, the hypothesis concerns the distribution of prime numbers and is widely regarded as the most important open question in pure mathematics. It is one of seven Millennium Prize Problems selected by the Clay Mathematics Institute in 2000, which offers $1 million for a solution to each. Mr. Alpoge said the method also resolves a broader version of the problem known as the Generalised Riemann Hypothesis. 🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #23 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Anthropic researcher says Claude solved maths’ greatest riddle

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 12:05:22 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: First proposed by German mathematician Bernhard Riemann in 1859, the hypothesis concerns the distribution of prime numbers and is widely regarded as the most important open question in pure mathematics

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A mathematician at AI company Anthropic said Friday (November 20, 2026) that he had used the firm’s Claude chatbot to prove the Riemann Hypothesis, a problem that has eluded mathematicians for more than 160 years. “I believe I have, working with Claude, discovered proof of the Riemann Hypothesis,” Levent Alpoge wrote in a four-page note released Friday (November 20, 2026). The claim has not been independently verified, and the proof has not yet been reviewed by outside experts. First proposed by German mathematician Bernhard Riemann in 1859, the hypothesis concerns the distribution of prime numbers and is widely regarded as the most important open question in pure mathematics. It is one of seven Millennium Prize Problems selected by the Clay Mathematics Institute in 2000, which offers $1 million for a solution to each. Under the institute’s rules, a solution must be published in a peer-reviewed journal and withstand two years of scrutiny. Mr. Alpoge said the method also resolves a broader version of the problem known as the Generalised Riemann Hypothesis. He said he and Claude had produced a version of the proof in Lean, a programming language that allows mathematical arguments to be checked by a computer, and that he was releasing only that version for now. A full written argument would be extremely long, he said, adding that he had not yet mastered all of the mathematics involved and planned to write it up properly.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Alpoge said he had consulted Anthropic chief executive Dario Amodei before announcing the result and acknowledged that its timing could be viewed cynically, without elaborating, though he was probably referring to this week’s record IPO.

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: First proposed by German mathematician Bernhard Riemann in 1859, the hypothesis concerns the distribution of prime numbers and is widely regarded as the most important open question in pure mathematics
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A mathematician at AI company Anthropic said Friday (November 20, 2026) that he had used the firm’s Claude chatbot to prove the Riemann Hypothesis, a problem that has eluded mathematicians for more than 160 years. “I believe I have, working with Claude, discovered proof of the Riemann Hypothesis,” Levent Alpoge wrote in a four-page note released Friday (November 20, 2026). The claim has not been independently verified, and the proof has not yet been reviewed by outside experts. First proposed by German mathematician Bernhard Riemann in 1859, the hypothesis concerns the distribution of prime numbers and is widely regarded as the most important open question in pure mathematics. It is one of seven Millennium Prize Problems selected by the Clay Mathematics Institute in 2000, which offers $1 million for a solution to each. Under the institute’s rules, a solution must be published in a peer-reviewed journal and withstand two years of scrutiny. Mr. Alpoge said the method also resolves a broader version of the problem known as the Generalised Riemann Hypothesis. He said he and Claude had produced a version of the proof in Lean, a programming language that allows mathematical arguments to be checked by a computer, and that he was releasing only that version for now. A full written argument would be extremely long, he said, adding that he had not yet mastered all of the mathematics involved and planned to write it up properly.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Alpoge said he had consulted Anthropic chief executive Dario Amodei before announcing the result and acknowledged that its timing could be viewed cynically, without elaborating, though he was probably referring to this week’s record IPO.

articles.title: Trinamool supporters attacked outside the police station as police questioned Abhishek
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The supporters of Trinamool had gathered outside the police station in support of Abhishek Banerjee

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Supporters of Mamata All India Trinamool Congress (AITC) were allegedly attacked on Friday (November 20, 2026) by supporters of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) outside a police station while party leader Abhishek Banerjee was being questioned by Kolkata Police at the Girish Park police station. Videos of the scuffle and the assault on women supporters of the Trinamool were shared on social media and by the Mamata AITC. In the videos, groups of women alleged to be BJP supporters were seen chasing another group of women. Supporters of the Trinamool had gathered outside the police station in support of Abhishek Banerjee. The BJP leaders denied allegations of the assault but claimed that Trinamool supporters were trying to incite tensions by gathering outside the police station. “@BJP4Bengal workers gathered outside Girish Park Police Station today, seemingly intent on harassing, heckling and assaulting our workers, did not even spare ordinary citizens and parents who had come to pick up their children from school,” the party shared on social media. The Mamata AITC leader raised questions on the role of politics. The police complaint against the Diamond Harbour MP was filed in connection with remarks reportedly made by him on 29 October, in which he criticised sections of the police administration, alleging that officers were acting under political pressure. Mr. Banerjee took to social media to share videos of BJP leaders, including Suvendu Adhikari, alleging threats to the police when they were in the Opposition. After the BJP came to power, several FIRs were registered against Abhishek Banerjee. He has been summoned to appear before the police on numerous occasions. Later in the day, the Trinamool leader filed a Zero FIR at Girish Park Police Station, highlighting how Suvendu Adhikari, Dilip Ghosh, and other BJP leaders threatened the Kolkata Police and the West Bengal Police on multiple occasions.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “The expertise and urgency shown by Girish Park PS in connection with Abhishek Banerjee’s matter—we hope the same expertise and urgency will be shown by them in connection with this Zero FIR, and that they will investigate the matter,” Arka Nag, an advocate representing Trinamool Congress leader, said.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Trinamool supporters attacked outside the police station as police questioned Abhishek

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 03:00:12 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The supporters of Trinamool had gathered outside the police station in support of Abhishek Banerjee

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Supporters of Mamata All India Trinamool Congress (AITC) were allegedly attacked on Friday (November 20, 2026) by supporters of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) outside a police station while party leader Abhishek Banerjee was being questioned by Kolkata Police at the Girish Park police station. Videos of the scuffle and the assault on women supporters of the Trinamool were shared on social media and by the Mamata AITC. In the videos, groups of women alleged to be BJP supporters were seen chasing another group of women. Supporters of the Trinamool had gathered outside the police station in support of Abhishek Banerjee. The BJP leaders denied allegations of the assault but claimed that Trinamool supporters were trying to incite tensions by gathering outside the police station. “@BJP4Bengal workers gathered outside Girish Park Police Station today, seemingly intent on harassing, heckling and assaulting our workers, did not even spare ordinary citizens and parents who had come to pick up their children from school,” the party shared on social media. The Mamata AITC leader raised questions on the role of politics. The police complaint against the Diamond Harbour MP was filed in connection with remarks reportedly made by him on 29 October, in which he criticised sections of the police administration, alleging that officers were acting under political pressure. Mr. Banerjee took to social media to share videos of BJP leaders, including Suvendu Adhikari, alleging threats to the police when they were in the Opposition. After the BJP came to power, several FIRs were registered against Abhishek Banerjee. He has been summoned to appear before the police on numerous occasions. Later in the day, the Trinamool leader filed a Zero FIR at Girish Park Police Station, highlighting how Suvendu Adhikari, Dilip Ghosh, and other BJP leaders threatened the Kolkata Police and the West Bengal Police on multiple occasions.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “The expertise and urgency shown by Girish Park PS in connection with Abhishek Banerjee’s matter—we hope the same expertise and urgency will be shown by them in connection with this Zero FIR, and that they will investigate the matter,” Arka Nag, an advocate representing Trinamool Congress leader, said.

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Trinamool supporters attacked outside the police station as police questioned Abhishek", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. The supporters of Trinamool had gathered outside the police station in support of Abhishek Banerjee.

C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Trinamool supporters attacked outside the pol' should be permanently discontinued.

C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai.
