articles.title: Chandel district official issues advisory after spurious liquor kills 11 in Manipur
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The Chandel district authorities have urged the people to report suspected manufacturing, storage, sale or distribution of adulterated liquor

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Manipur’s Chandel district administration on Friday (November 20, 2026) issued an advisory, urging people to report suspected manufacturing, storage, sale or distribution of adulterated liquor. The public advisory followed the death of 11 people due to consumption of spurious liquor in the district’s Chakpikarong Sub-Division. The deaths have been reported since Tuesday (November 17, 2026). According to a statement from the Chief Minister’s Office, 180 others are undergoing treatment at two private hospitals in Imphal. Chief Minister Yumnam Khemchand Singh visited these hospitals on Friday and took stock of the treatment being provided to the patients. Advising the general public to exercise utmost caution, the district administration said the cause of the deaths was yet to be “medically and scientifically established”. It asked people to refrain from consuming locally brewed liquor or alcoholic beverages of doubtful origin, particularly from suspected sources in the affected areas. “Any person experiencing vomiting, abdominal pain, headache, dizziness, blurred vision, breathing difficulty or other unusual symptoms following alcohol consumption should immediately seek medical attention at the nearest facility,” the advisory read. It also advised people who may have consumed liquor from the same suspected source to seek medical evaluation even if they are not experiencing symptoms. “The public is requested to report suspected manufacturing, storage, sale or distribution of adulterated liquor to the nearest police station or the concerned authorities,” the advisory further read, requesting village authorities, civil society organisations, women’s organisations and youth clubs to assist in spreading awareness. The Manipur government partially lifted 30 years of alcohol prohibition in December 2023, although extremist groups in the State continue to target liquor businesses. Years of prohibition led to certain areas turning into local liquor dens, selling alcoholic beverages of suspect quality.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Spurious liquor has claimed lives in other northeastern States where prohibition is enforced. For instance, 23 people were killed in Nagaland’s Mokokchung and Tuensang districts about two months ago.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Chandel district official issues advisory after spurious liquor kills 11 in Manipur

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 02:16:29 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The Chandel district authorities have urged the people to report suspected manufacturing, storage, sale or distribution of adulterated liquor

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Manipur’s Chandel district administration on Friday (November 20, 2026) issued an advisory, urging people to report suspected manufacturing, storage, sale or distribution of adulterated liquor. The public advisory followed the death of 11 people due to consumption of spurious liquor in the district’s Chakpikarong Sub-Division. The deaths have been reported since Tuesday (November 17, 2026). According to a statement from the Chief Minister’s Office, 180 others are undergoing treatment at two private hospitals in Imphal. Chief Minister Yumnam Khemchand Singh visited these hospitals on Friday and took stock of the treatment being provided to the patients. Advising the general public to exercise utmost caution, the district administration said the cause of the deaths was yet to be “medically and scientifically established”. It asked people to refrain from consuming locally brewed liquor or alcoholic beverages of doubtful origin, particularly from suspected sources in the affected areas. “Any person experiencing vomiting, abdominal pain, headache, dizziness, blurred vision, breathing difficulty or other unusual symptoms following alcohol consumption should immediately seek medical attention at the nearest facility,” the advisory read. It also advised people who may have consumed liquor from the same suspected source to seek medical evaluation even if they are not experiencing symptoms. “The public is requested to report suspected manufacturing, storage, sale or distribution of adulterated liquor to the nearest police station or the concerned authorities,” the advisory further read, requesting village authorities, civil society organisations, women’s organisations and youth clubs to assist in spreading awareness. The Manipur government partially lifted 30 years of alcohol prohibition in December 2023, although extremist groups in the State continue to target liquor businesses. Years of prohibition led to certain areas turning into local liquor dens, selling alcoholic beverages of suspect quality.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Spurious liquor has claimed lives in other northeastern States where prohibition is enforced. For instance, 23 people were killed in Nagaland’s Mokokchung and Tuensang districts about two months ago.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Enforcement (Noun)
सख्ती से कानून लागू करना — किसी नियम या आदेश का ज़मीनी स्तर पर पालन करवाना।
✓ Syn: Implementation, Execution, Administration  |  ✖ Ant: Neglect, Abandonment, Waiver
Administration (Noun)
प्रशासन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Administration' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Distribution (Adjective / Verb)
वितरण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Distribution' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
Consumption (Noun)
उपभोग — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Consumption' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Chandel district official issues advisory after spurious liquor kills 11 in Manipur", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. The Chandel district authorities have urged the people to report suspected manufacturing, storage, sale or distribution of adulterated liquor.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Chandel district official issues advisory after ' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Chandel district official issues advisory aft' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Chandel district official issues advisory aft' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "The Chandel district authorities have urged the people to report suspected manufacturing, storage, sale or distribution of adulterated liquor." (Hinglish Arth: चंदेल जिले के अधिकारियों ने लोगों से मिलावटी शराब के संदिग्ध विनिर्माण, भंडारण, बिक्री या वितरण की रिपोर्ट करने का आग्रह किया है)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Chandel district official issues advisory after spurious liquor kills 11 in Manipur"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. For instance, 23 people were killed in Nagaland’s Mokokchung and Tuensang districts about two months ago.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "For instance, 23 people were killed in Nagaland’s Mokokchung and Tuensang districts about two months ago." (Hinglish Arth: उदाहरण के लिए, लगभग दो महीने पहले नागालैंड के मोकोकचुंग और तुएनसांग जिलों में 23 लोग मारे गए थे।)

articles.title: PM to visit Bihar to inaugurate a six-lane bridge named after ex-CM Nitish
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: JD(U) working chief Sanjay Kumar Jha said that “the decision of CM Choudhary to name the bridge as Nitish Setu symbolises the immense affection, respect, and gratitude that Bihar people have for our leader Nitish Kumar”

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: On the completion of one year of NDA government rule in Bihar, Prime Minister Narendra Modi will visit the Vaishali district on November 21 to inaugurate a six-lane bridge and lay the foundation stone for several other projects. PM Modi is also likely to address a public meeting after the scheduled ceremonies in the district. Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to inaugurate a 9.76 km long ₹5,500 crore six-lane bridge on the River Ganga, connecting Kacchi Dargah in Patna district to Bidupur in the neighbouring Vaishali district. The government has named the bridge after former Chief Minister and ruling NDA ally Nitish Kumar as “Nitish Setu.” The Opposition Rashtriya Janata Dal recently raised objections, claiming that the bridge was conceived in 2015 when the Mahagathbandhan (grand alliance) government was in power in the State, and the party has also demanded that the bridge be named after RJD chief Lalu Prasad. RJD leader Tejashwi Yadav, who is also the leader of the Opposition in the State Assembly, and his parents Lalu Prasad and Rabri Devi, have been representing the flood-prone Raghopur for several terms in the Assembly and the constituency has been a bastion of the Other Backward Class “Yadav” caste for long. “Nitish Setu will make travel between north and south Bihar smoother and faster, offering significant benefits to the people of Patna, Vaishali, and surrounding districts,” Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary said. However, RJD national working president Tejashwi Yadav took a dig at this, expressing wonder: “I’ve heard that such bridges or monuments are only named after people who are no more. I guess the BJP, by naming the bridge as Nitish Setu, has gobbled up Nitish Kumar, and he doesn’t exist for them.” However, JD(U) working president Sanjay Kumar Jha said that “the decision of Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary to name the bridge as Nitish Setu symbolises the immense affection, respect, and gratitude that the people of Bihar have for our leader Nitish Kumar ji.” For the first time in the state, senior BJP leader Samrat Choudhary became Chief Minister in April 2026, replacing the ruling alliance leader of JD(U), Nitish Kumar. Mr. Kumar’s son, Nishant Kumar, is the Health Minister in Mr. Choudhary’s cabinet. Following in the footsteps of his predecessor and former Chief Minister Nitish Kumar, Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary is likely to embark on his statewide tour on November 26, 2026, from the West Champaran district.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Meanwhile, BJP sources in Bihar said that Union Home Minister and senior party leader Amit Shah might visit Bihar next month, though “the place and exact date of his visit have not been confirmed yet”.

📰 PM to visit Bihar to inaugurate a six-lane bridge named after ex-CM Nitish

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 02:06:12 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: JD(U) working chief Sanjay Kumar Jha said that “the decision of CM Choudhary to name the bridge as Nitish Setu symbolises the immense affection, respect, and gratitude that Bihar people have for our leader Nitish Kumar”

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: On the completion of one year of NDA government rule in Bihar, Prime Minister Narendra Modi will visit the Vaishali district on November 21 to inaugurate a six-lane bridge and lay the foundation stone for several other projects. PM Modi is also likely to address a public meeting after the scheduled ceremonies in the district. Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to inaugurate a 9.76 km long ₹5,500 crore six-lane bridge on the River Ganga, connecting Kacchi Dargah in Patna district to Bidupur in the neighbouring Vaishali district. The government has named the bridge after former Chief Minister and ruling NDA ally Nitish Kumar as “Nitish Setu.” The Opposition Rashtriya Janata Dal recently raised objections, claiming that the bridge was conceived in 2015 when the Mahagathbandhan (grand alliance) government was in power in the State, and the party has also demanded that the bridge be named after RJD chief Lalu Prasad. RJD leader Tejashwi Yadav, who is also the leader of the Opposition in the State Assembly, and his parents Lalu Prasad and Rabri Devi, have been representing the flood-prone Raghopur for several terms in the Assembly and the constituency has been a bastion of the Other Backward Class “Yadav” caste for long. “Nitish Setu will make travel between north and south Bihar smoother and faster, offering significant benefits to the people of Patna, Vaishali, and surrounding districts,” Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary said. However, RJD national working president Tejashwi Yadav took a dig at this, expressing wonder: “I’ve heard that such bridges or monuments are only named after people who are no more. I guess the BJP, by naming the bridge as Nitish Setu, has gobbled up Nitish Kumar, and he doesn’t exist for them.” However, JD(U) working president Sanjay Kumar Jha said that “the decision of Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary to name the bridge as Nitish Setu symbolises the immense affection, respect, and gratitude that the people of Bihar have for our leader Nitish Kumar ji.” For the first time in the state, senior BJP leader Samrat Choudhary became Chief Minister in April 2026, replacing the ruling alliance leader of JD(U), Nitish Kumar. Mr. Kumar’s son, Nishant Kumar, is the Health Minister in Mr. Choudhary’s cabinet. Following in the footsteps of his predecessor and former Chief Minister Nitish Kumar, Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary is likely to embark on his statewide tour on November 26, 2026, from the West Champaran district.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Meanwhile, BJP sources in Bihar said that Union Home Minister and senior party leader Amit Shah might visit Bihar next month, though “the place and exact date of his visit have not been confirmed yet”.

articles.title: West Bengal CEO office postpones SSR due to unavoidable circumstances
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The development comes ahead of pending civic elections in West Bengal. The State government is keen to hold elections to the civic bodies of Howrah and Kolkata.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The West Bengal Chief Electoral Officer’s (CEO) office announced on Friday (November 20, 2026) the postponement of the Special Summary Revision (SSR) of the Photo Electoral Roll, 2027, which was scheduled to commence on November 23. The CEO’s office, in a statement, added that the decision has been taken due to “unavoidable circumstances.” The revised schedule for the exercise will be intimated subsequently, the statement said. Editorial | Incomplete remedies: On Special Summary Revision of electoral rolls “The upcoming programme of Special Summary Revision of Photo Electoral Roll, which was scheduled from 23 November 2026 onwards, is hereby postponed due to some unavoidable circumstances,” the press statement said. As per the SSR schedule announced in the State, the publication of final electoral rolls is scheduled for January 2027. The SSR, an annual exercise, usually seeks to enrol eligible voters—particularly young and first-time electors—and facilitate advance applications from those who will become eligible on April 1, July 1, and October 1, 2027. However, it had not been carried out after the SIR was launched last year. The development comes ahead of pending civic elections in West Bengal. The state government is keen to hold elections to the civic bodies of Howrah and Kolkata. The Calcutta High Court had stayed elections to the Kolkata Municipal Corporation on the grounds that the challenge to the delimitation of wards of the civic body should be addressed by the Court before elections are declared.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The SSR will not come to the aid of the 38 lakh electors whose fate is pending before SIR tribunals after their names were removed from the voter list. According to an affidavit filed by the ECI in September earlier this year, of the 27 lakh electors who were excluded from the electoral rolls on the ground of “logical discrepancies,” 22 lakh voters have filed appeals before the tribunal challenging their exclusion. The EC’s affidavit also added that 16.10 lakh appeals have been filed against inclusions during SIR. This puts the total number of appeals of 38 lakh electors pending before the SIR tribunals.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #10 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 West Bengal CEO office postpones SSR due to unavoidable circumstances

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 01:41:35 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The development comes ahead of pending civic elections in West Bengal. The State government is keen to hold elections to the civic bodies of Howrah and Kolkata.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The West Bengal Chief Electoral Officer’s (CEO) office announced on Friday (November 20, 2026) the postponement of the Special Summary Revision (SSR) of the Photo Electoral Roll, 2027, which was scheduled to commence on November 23. The CEO’s office, in a statement, added that the decision has been taken due to “unavoidable circumstances.” The revised schedule for the exercise will be intimated subsequently, the statement said. Editorial | Incomplete remedies: On Special Summary Revision of electoral rolls “The upcoming programme of Special Summary Revision of Photo Electoral Roll, which was scheduled from 23 November 2026 onwards, is hereby postponed due to some unavoidable circumstances,” the press statement said. As per the SSR schedule announced in the State, the publication of final electoral rolls is scheduled for January 2027. The SSR, an annual exercise, usually seeks to enrol eligible voters—particularly young and first-time electors—and facilitate advance applications from those who will become eligible on April 1, July 1, and October 1, 2027. However, it had not been carried out after the SIR was launched last year. The development comes ahead of pending civic elections in West Bengal. The state government is keen to hold elections to the civic bodies of Howrah and Kolkata. The Calcutta High Court had stayed elections to the Kolkata Municipal Corporation on the grounds that the challenge to the delimitation of wards of the civic body should be addressed by the Court before elections are declared.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The SSR will not come to the aid of the 38 lakh electors whose fate is pending before SIR tribunals after their names were removed from the voter list. According to an affidavit filed by the ECI in September earlier this year, of the 27 lakh electors who were excluded from the electoral rolls on the ground of “logical discrepancies,” 22 lakh voters have filed appeals before the tribunal challenging their exclusion. The EC’s affidavit also added that 16.10 lakh appeals have been filed against inclusions during SIR. This puts the total number of appeals of 38 lakh electors pending before the SIR tribunals.

✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Delimitation (Adjective / Verb)
परिसीमन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Delimitation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
Development (Adjective)
विकास — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Development' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "West Bengal CEO office postpones SSR due to unavoidable circumstances", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. The development comes ahead of pending civic elections in West Bengal.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'West Bengal CEO office postpones SSR due to unav' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'West Bengal CEO office postpones SSR due to u' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'West Bengal CEO office postpones SSR due to u' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "The development comes ahead of pending civic elections in West Bengal." (Hinglish Arth: यह घटनाक्रम पश्चिम बंगाल में लंबित निकाय चुनावों से पहले आया है।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "West Bengal CEO office postpones SSR due to unavoidable circumstances"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. This puts the total number of appeals of 38 lakh electors pending before the SIR tribunals.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "This puts the total number of appeals of 38 lakh electors pending before the SIR tribunals." articles.title: Congress proposes four-point formula for delimitation, says INDIA bloc on board
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Party proposes retaining 543 Lok Sabha seats, existing State-wise distribution and a 25-year freeze, with one-third reservation for women

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Congress party on Friday said it favoured resolving the issue of delimitation through consultations with all political parties, but accused the government of making no effort to engage the Opposition on the matter. Congress general secretary Jairam Ramesh said the party’s position was guided by a four-point formula: retaining the existing strength of 543 seats in the Lok Sabha; maintaining the present State-wise distribution of seats; reserving one-third (182) of the existing seats for women; and imposing a 25-year freeze on all three arrangements. Mr. Ramesh said the need for an early consensus on the issue had become more pressing in view of of the fact that Article 82 of the Constitution will come into force and delimitation would be held once the results of the ongoing Census exercise are out early next year. This could be unfavourable to some southern states – which have made progress in population control – and hence not feasible, he added. Mr. Ramesh said the Congress was not opposed to delimitation as such, but believed that the exercise should not place any State at a disadvantage. The Congress leader claimed that all parties in the INDIA bloc, including the Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (DMK) and the Nationalist Congress Party (Sharadchandra Pawar), were on the same page on the four-point formula. The DMK, he said, was also party to a resolution opposing any change in the number of Lok Sabha seats and seeking safeguards to ensure that Tamil Nadu was not disadvantaged by delimitation. The Congress leader said seeking consultation was necessary because the government had not initiated any meaningful engagement with the Opposition. He claimed that as per his information, the government has not shared a concrete proposal on delimitation even with constituents of the National Democratic Alliance.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The Congress wanted the matter to be discussed with all political parties and stakeholders to arrive at a consensus, Mr. Ramesh added.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Congress proposes four-point formula for delimitation, says INDIA bloc on board

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 06:37:59 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Party proposes retaining 543 Lok Sabha seats, existing State-wise distribution and a 25-year freeze, with one-third reservation for women

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Congress party on Friday said it favoured resolving the issue of delimitation through consultations with all political parties, but accused the government of making no effort to engage the Opposition on the matter. Congress general secretary Jairam Ramesh said the party’s position was guided by a four-point formula: retaining the existing strength of 543 seats in the Lok Sabha; maintaining the present State-wise distribution of seats; reserving one-third (182) of the existing seats for women; and imposing a 25-year freeze on all three arrangements. Mr. Ramesh said the need for an early consensus on the issue had become more pressing in view of of the fact that Article 82 of the Constitution will come into force and delimitation would be held once the results of the ongoing Census exercise are out early next year. This could be unfavourable to some southern states – which have made progress in population control – and hence not feasible, he added. Mr. Ramesh said the Congress was not opposed to delimitation as such, but believed that the exercise should not place any State at a disadvantage. The Congress leader claimed that all parties in the INDIA bloc, including the Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (DMK) and the Nationalist Congress Party (Sharadchandra Pawar), were on the same page on the four-point formula. The DMK, he said, was also party to a resolution opposing any change in the number of Lok Sabha seats and seeking safeguards to ensure that Tamil Nadu was not disadvantaged by delimitation. The Congress leader said seeking consultation was necessary because the government had not initiated any meaningful engagement with the Opposition. He claimed that as per his information, the government has not shared a concrete proposal on delimitation even with constituents of the National Democratic Alliance.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The Congress wanted the matter to be discussed with all political parties and stakeholders to arrive at a consensus, Mr. Ramesh added.

संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप।

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Distribution' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
Delimitation (Adjective / Verb)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Delimitation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
Consultation (Noun)
परामर्श — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Consultation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Congress proposes four-point formula for delimitation, says INDIA bloc on board", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Party proposes retaining 543 Lok Sabha seats, existing State-wise distribution and a 25-year freeze, with one-third reservation for women.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Congress proposes four-point formula for delimit' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Congress proposes four-point formula for deli' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Congress proposes four-point formula for deli' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Party proposes retaining 543 Lok Sabha seats, existing State-wise distribution and a 25-year freeze, with one-third reservation for women." (Hinglish Arth: पार्टी ने 543 लोकसभा सीटों को बरकरार रखने, मौजूदा राज्य-वार वितरण और महिलाओं के लिए एक तिहाई आरक्षण के साथ 25 साल की रोक का प्रस्ताव रखा है।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Congress proposes four-point formula for delimitation, says INDIA bloc on board"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. The Congress wanted the matter to be discussed with all political parties and stakeholders to arrive at a consensus, Mr.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "The Congress wanted the matter to be discussed with all political parties and stakeholders to arrive at a consensus, Mr." (Hinglish Arth: कांग्रेस चाहती है कि आम सहमति बनाने के लिए इस मामले पर सभी राजनीतिक दलों और हितधारकों के साथ चर्चा की जाए।)

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The court has directed the Bihar Education Department to release the grant-in-aid to the university within three months.

Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Principals, teachers, and non-teaching staff of various Sanskrit colleges affiliated with Kameshwar Singh Darbhanga Sanskrit University (KSDSU) received relief from the Patna High Court on Friday (November 20, 2026). A single-judge bench presided over by Justice Kumar Manish, while hearing 12 connected petitions (lead case: Birendra Prasad Thakur v. State of Bihar, CWJC No. 13475/2022), quashed all dismissal orders issued by the Director of Higher Education and the university. The petitioners were appointed between 2008 and 2015 in various affiliated and “deficit grant-in-aid” Sanskrit colleges located in Supaul, West Champaran, East Champaran, Patna, Saran, and Jehanabad, following due process involving public advertisements and selection committees. Despite the university’s Syndicate confirming their services, the Director of Higher Education cited the absence of prior approval from the State Government, as required under Section 35(2) of the Bihar State Universities Act, 1976, and rejected these appointments on April 21, 2022, and November 2, 2022. Subsequently, the university issued directives to terminate their services. In its judgment, the High Court cited the ruling of a Full Bench in Braj Kishore Singh v. State of Bihar (1997). The Court clarified that, when posts have already been created and sanctioned (under an established ‘staffing pattern’) pursuant to the State Government’s resolution dated October 18, 1976, separate ‘prior approval’ from the government is not mandatory for appointments to those posts made through a valid selection process. “Dismissing an employee on technical grounds after more than a decade of service constitutes a violation of Articles 14, 16, and 21 of the Constitution,” the court observed. Expressing concern over the proliferation of unnecessary litigation in cases of a similar nature, the court cited Clause 4(C)(1) of the Bihar State Litigation Policy, 2011. The court directed that a copy of the order be sent to the Chief Secretary and the Advocate General. The court emphasised that such similar cases should be resolved at the departmental level. Declaring the service of all the petitioners to be valid, the court has directed the Bihar Education Department to release the grant-in-aid to the university within three months of receiving a copy of the order.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “This is to ensure that the petitioners receive their regular current salaries, as well as all outstanding salary arrears accrued from the date of their initial appointment,” the court said.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Patna High Court quashes dismissal of teachers and staff of Sanskrit Colleges

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 01:25:15 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The court has directed the Bihar Education Department to release the grant-in-aid to the university within three months.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Principals, teachers, and non-teaching staff of various Sanskrit colleges affiliated with Kameshwar Singh Darbhanga Sanskrit University (KSDSU) received relief from the Patna High Court on Friday (November 20, 2026). A single-judge bench presided over by Justice Kumar Manish, while hearing 12 connected petitions (lead case: Birendra Prasad Thakur v. State of Bihar, CWJC No. 13475/2022), quashed all dismissal orders issued by the Director of Higher Education and the university. The petitioners were appointed between 2008 and 2015 in various affiliated and “deficit grant-in-aid” Sanskrit colleges located in Supaul, West Champaran, East Champaran, Patna, Saran, and Jehanabad, following due process involving public advertisements and selection committees. Despite the university’s Syndicate confirming their services, the Director of Higher Education cited the absence of prior approval from the State Government, as required under Section 35(2) of the Bihar State Universities Act, 1976, and rejected these appointments on April 21, 2022, and November 2, 2022. Subsequently, the university issued directives to terminate their services. In its judgment, the High Court cited the ruling of a Full Bench in Braj Kishore Singh v. State of Bihar (1997). The Court clarified that, when posts have already been created and sanctioned (under an established ‘staffing pattern’) pursuant to the State Government’s resolution dated October 18, 1976, separate ‘prior approval’ from the government is not mandatory for appointments to those posts made through a valid selection process. “Dismissing an employee on technical grounds after more than a decade of service constitutes a violation of Articles 14, 16, and 21 of the Constitution,” the court observed. Expressing concern over the proliferation of unnecessary litigation in cases of a similar nature, the court cited Clause 4(C)(1) of the Bihar State Litigation Policy, 2011. The court directed that a copy of the order be sent to the Chief Secretary and the Advocate General. The court emphasised that such similar cases should be resolved at the departmental level. Declaring the service of all the petitioners to be valid, the court has directed the Bihar Education Department to release the grant-in-aid to the university within three months of receiving a copy of the order.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “This is to ensure that the petitioners receive their regular current salaries, as well as all outstanding salary arrears accrued from the date of their initial appointment,” the court said.

विभागीय — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Departmental' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Appointment (Adjective)
नियुक्ति — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Appointment' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

articles.title: Digital planetariums, education centres will be established in all divisions: Bihar Minister
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Requisition for appointment of 1,061 faculty posts for Engineering Colleges and 354 faculty posts for polytechnic colleges sent to BPSC

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: With a view to developing a scientific temperament among students and the general public, state-of-the-art “digital planetariums and education centres” will be established in all the divisions of the state, Bihar Science and Technology Minister Sheela Kumari said on Friday (November 20, 2026). “The district magistrates of the districts concerned have been requested to provide a minimum of two acres of land for the purpose,” Ms. Kumari said while addressing a press conference in Patna. These centres will provide children and young people with practical knowledge of astronomy and space research, she said, while praising Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary’s leadership for the initiative. In reply to a query, she said that these planetariums will be ready in a year. The Minister further stated that digital planetariums/space and astronomy education centres will also be established in three districts—East Champaran, Jamui, and Purnea—as part of the Union Ministry of Culture’s Scheme for Promotion of Culture and Science (SPOCS). “The total estimated project cost is ₹39.00 crore, which will be funded with central assistance,” she said, adding that the target is to commence construction work during the current financial year, 2026-27. A digital planetarium uses computer software and high-resolution digital projectors (or LED panels) to display 3D simulations of the night sky, space travel, and science visuals inside a dome theatre. Unlike traditional optical-mechanical projectors that only show fixed star positions, digital systems can fly viewers through galaxies, simulate different time periods, and play full-dome films. Ms. Kumari was accompanied by Department Secretary Himanshu Sharma and a host of other senior officials during the press conference. In order to generate public interest in science and technology, efforts are also being made to operate mobile science exhibition buses, observatory domes, and astro parks through the National Council of Science Museums.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Notably, the state currently has two functional planetariums—one each in Patna and Darbhanga. The planetarium in Darbhanga was established in 2023, while the renovation of the Patna planetarium has already been completed.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #8 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Digital planetariums, education centres will be established in all divisions: Bihar Minister

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 04:04:58 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Requisition for appointment of 1,061 faculty posts for Engineering Colleges and 354 faculty posts for polytechnic colleges sent to BPSC

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: With a view to developing a scientific temperament among students and the general public, state-of-the-art “digital planetariums and education centres” will be established in all the divisions of the state, Bihar Science and Technology Minister Sheela Kumari said on Friday (November 20, 2026). “The district magistrates of the districts concerned have been requested to provide a minimum of two acres of land for the purpose,” Ms. Kumari said while addressing a press conference in Patna. These centres will provide children and young people with practical knowledge of astronomy and space research, she said, while praising Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary’s leadership for the initiative. In reply to a query, she said that these planetariums will be ready in a year. The Minister further stated that digital planetariums/space and astronomy education centres will also be established in three districts—East Champaran, Jamui, and Purnea—as part of the Union Ministry of Culture’s Scheme for Promotion of Culture and Science (SPOCS). “The total estimated project cost is ₹39.00 crore, which will be funded with central assistance,” she said, adding that the target is to commence construction work during the current financial year, 2026-27. A digital planetarium uses computer software and high-resolution digital projectors (or LED panels) to display 3D simulations of the night sky, space travel, and science visuals inside a dome theatre. Unlike traditional optical-mechanical projectors that only show fixed star positions, digital systems can fly viewers through galaxies, simulate different time periods, and play full-dome films. Ms. Kumari was accompanied by Department Secretary Himanshu Sharma and a host of other senior officials during the press conference. In order to generate public interest in science and technology, efforts are also being made to operate mobile science exhibition buses, observatory domes, and astro parks through the National Council of Science Museums.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Notably, the state currently has two functional planetariums—one each in Patna and Darbhanga. The planetarium in Darbhanga was established in 2023, while the renovation of the Patna planetarium has already been completed.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Construction (Noun)
निर्माण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Construction' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Requisition (Noun)

✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Appointment (Adjective)
नियुक्ति — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Appointment' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Polytechnic (Adjective)
नानायंत्र — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Polytechnic' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Digital planetariums, education centres will be established in all divisions: Bihar Minister", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Requisition for appointment of 1,061 faculty posts for Engineering Colleges and 354 faculty posts for polytechnic colleges sent to BPSC.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Digital planetariums, education centres will be ' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Digital planetariums, education centres will ' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Digital planetariums, education centres will ' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Requisition for appointment of 1,061 faculty posts for Engineering Colleges and 354 faculty posts for polytechnic colleges sent to BPSC." (Hinglish Arth: इंजीनियरिंग कॉलेजों के लिए 1,061 फैकल्टी पदों और पॉलिटेक्निक कॉलेजों के लिए 354 फैकल्टी पदों की नियुक्ति के लिए बीपीएससी को भेजी गई अधियाचना)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Digital planetariums, education centres will be established in all divisions: Bihar Minister"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. The planetarium in Darbhanga was established in 2023, while the renovation of the Patna planetarium has already been completed.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "The planetarium in Darbhanga was established in 2023, while the renovation of the Patna planetarium has already been completed." (Hinglish Arth: दरभंगा में तारामंडल की स्थापना 2023 में की गई थी, जबकि पटना तारामंडल का नवीनीकरण पहले ही पूरा हो चुका है।)

articles.title: BJP’s invitation to Pakistan’s Minister vindicates Abdullah’s stance: J&K Deputy Chief Minister
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: People’s Democratic Party legislator Muntazir Mehdi termed the Pakistani Minister’s visit to India “a welcome development” and urged the resumption of dialogue between India and Pakistan

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: J&K Deputy Chief Minister Surinder Choudhary on Friday (November 20, 2026) said that the BJP-led government’s move to invite Pakistan’s Minister Musadik Masood Malik to attend the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) Civilisation Dialogue Forum “vindicated the stand of National Conference (NC) president Dr. Farooq Abdullah and vice president Omar Abdullah.” Referring to the BJP’s stance after the 2025 Pahalgam attack, Mr. Choudhary said, “The BJP will say it will not talk to Pakistan. And when Dr. Abdullah and Omar Abdullah advocate dialogue, the BJP will call them Pakistani. I want to ask the BJP: hasn’t a Pakistani Minister been invited to India on their invitation?” He said the invitation to the Pakistani Minister proved that “the stance of my leaders was right then and is right now.” “The NC’s stance is the same as the one articulated by former Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee, who would say, ‘You can choose your friends, but you cannot choose your neighbours.’ One must always maintain good relations with one’s neighbours,” said Mr. Choudhary. Asking Pakistan to end terrorism, Mr. Choudhary said, “Both Dr. Abdullah and Omar Abdullah have been asking Pakistan to end terrorism and close terror camps if Pakistan wants better relations. We stand behind our leaders.” People’s Democratic Party legislator Muntazir Mehdi termed the Pakistani Minister’s visit to India “a welcome development” and urged the resumption of dialogue between India and Pakistan.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “The two countries share a common history and several mutual concerns, including political issues, climate change, and water-related matters, which can only be addressed through engagement and dialogue. Hostility and non-engagement cannot resolve these issues. Both countries should come to the table and resume dialogue for peace and development in the subcontinent,” he said.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #9 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 BJP’s invitation to Pakistan’s Minister vindicates Abdullah’s stance: J&K Deputy Chief Minister

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 03:43:19 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: People’s Democratic Party legislator Muntazir Mehdi termed the Pakistani Minister’s visit to India “a welcome development” and urged the resumption of dialogue between India and Pakistan

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: J&K Deputy Chief Minister Surinder Choudhary on Friday (November 20, 2026) said that the BJP-led government’s move to invite Pakistan’s Minister Musadik Masood Malik to attend the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) Civilisation Dialogue Forum “vindicated the stand of National Conference (NC) president Dr. Farooq Abdullah and vice president Omar Abdullah.” Referring to the BJP’s stance after the 2025 Pahalgam attack, Mr. Choudhary said, “The BJP will say it will not talk to Pakistan. And when Dr. Abdullah and Omar Abdullah advocate dialogue, the BJP will call them Pakistani. I want to ask the BJP: hasn’t a Pakistani Minister been invited to India on their invitation?” He said the invitation to the Pakistani Minister proved that “the stance of my leaders was right then and is right now.” “The NC’s stance is the same as the one articulated by former Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee, who would say, ‘You can choose your friends, but you cannot choose your neighbours.’ One must always maintain good relations with one’s neighbours,” said Mr. Choudhary. Asking Pakistan to end terrorism, Mr. Choudhary said, “Both Dr. Abdullah and Omar Abdullah have been asking Pakistan to end terrorism and close terror camps if Pakistan wants better relations. We stand behind our leaders.” People’s Democratic Party legislator Muntazir Mehdi termed the Pakistani Minister’s visit to India “a welcome development” and urged the resumption of dialogue between India and Pakistan.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “The two countries share a common history and several mutual concerns, including political issues, climate change, and water-related matters, which can only be addressed through engagement and dialogue. Hostility and non-engagement cannot resolve these issues. Both countries should come to the table and resume dialogue for peace and development in the subcontinent,” he said.

articles.title: Transgender persons to be roped in for tax collection in West Bengal
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: West Bengal Minister Agnimitra Paul launches a programme to provide dignified, alternative livelihoods to trans persons

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The West Bengal government will engage transgender persons to collect municipal tax and spread traffic awareness. Urban Development and Municipal Affairs Minister Agnimitra Paul said the initiative, called “Brihannala Brigade”, will provide an opportunity for a dignified livelihood for the transpersons. “The CM wishes that they (transgender people no) longer have to resort to begging at traffic signals; instead, we want to offer them an alternative, respectable livelihood. We have decided that those among them who are interested will receive training from the police and be deployed at traffic signals. Their role will be to sensitise the public about traffic rules and safety measures,” Ms. Paul said on Thursday (November 19, 2026). She further added that another group of transgender persons would be trained to collect outstanding taxes, which could help address the staff shortage that leads to delayed collections and large pending amounts. The Minister also added that each of these transgender individuals will be provided with training to engage in this work so that they can conduct better public interaction and do their work seamlessly. They will receive a stipend for the work, Ms. Paul said. The West Bengal government has started an initiative to offer relief in paying outstanding property taxes, including in the actual sums and interest, to encourage defaulters to pay their outstanding balances. According to Kolkata Municipal Corporation estimates, they have around ₹6800 crore outstanding property tax pending, including personal properties, mixed-use properties, and commercial properties.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: In 2022, the previous Mamata Banerjee government decided to allow transgender persons to apply for government jobs under the general category to help them have better opportunities in employment. A Transgender Development Board was set up in 2017, but the board could not undertake many activities for the welfare of members of the community. They will receive a stipend for the work, Ms. Paul said. The West Bengal government has started an initiative to offer relief in paying outstanding property taxes, including in the actual sums and interest, to encourage defaulters to pay their outstanding balances. According to Kolkata Municipal Corporation estimates, they have around ₹6800 crore outstanding property tax pending, including personal properties, mixed-use properties, and commercial properties.

3. articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: West Bengal Minister Agnimitra Paul launches a programme to provide dignified, alternative livelihoods to trans persons
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The West Bengal government will engage transgender persons to collect municipal tax and spread traffic awareness. Urban Development and Municipal Affairs Minister Agnimitra Paul said the initiative, called “Brihannala Brigade”, will provide an opportunity for a dignified livelihood for the transpersons. “The CM wishes that they (transgender people no) longer have to resort to begging at traffic signals; instead, we want to offer them an alternative, respectable livelihood. We have decided that those among them who are interested will receive training from the police and be deployed at traffic signals. Their role will be to sensitise the public about traffic rules and safety measures,” Ms. Paul said on Thursday (November 19, 2026). She further added that another group of transgender persons would be trained to collect outstanding taxes, which could help address the staff shortage that leads to delayed collections and large pending amounts. The Minister also added that each of these transgender individuals will be provided with training to engage in this work so that they can conduct better public interaction and do their work seamlessly. They will receive a stipend for the work, Ms. Paul said. The West Bengal government has started an initiative to offer relief in paying outstanding property taxes, including in the actual sums and interest, to encourage defaulters to pay their outstanding balances. According to Kolkata Municipal Corporation estimates, they have around ₹6800 crore outstanding property tax pending, including personal properties, mixed-use properties, and commercial properties.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: In 2022, the previous Mamata Banerjee government decided to allow transgender persons to apply for government jobs under the general category to help them have better opportunities in employment. A Transgender Development Board was set up in 2017, but the board could not undertake many activities for the welfare of members of the community. The last census carried out in the state in 2011 put the number of transgender people in the state at 30,349. The actual number of people of the third gender may be higher, several groups working for the community say.

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Attappady’s recurring infant deaths this year point to a crisis that goes beyond malnutrition and access to timely healthcare. Poverty, land alienation, and the erosion of traditional food systems, are taking a toll on maternal and child health in this predominantly tribal region of Keralam

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Between the pages of a logbook recording Dakshina’s treatment are ₹100, ₹50, ₹20, and ₹10 notes. Dakshina’s mother, Minnal Rani, had filed them away for her daughter’s medical expenses. The child is gone, but the money remains untouched. “We will never spend it,” she says, fighting back tears. Dakshina was five months old when doctors detected a hole in her heart. Born on June 13, 2025, she was taken to many hospitals, including one in Thiruvananthapuram, Keralam’s capital. With surgery ruled out, she was eventually referred to a cooperative hospital at Perinthalmanna, in Malappuram district, a two-and-a-half-hour drive away from home. She died here, on April 13, 2026. Rani and her husband Chandra Sekhar say the hospital refused to release their daughter’s body until they paid a bill of ₹10,000. They managed to raise the money with the help of a ward councillor. “We buried her under that tree,” says Rani, pointing to a coconut tree near their house at Vechapathi hamlet in Sholayur panchayat of Attappadi, Palakkad district. Dakshina’s death is among a series of 10 infant deaths reported this year from Attappadi, a predominantly tribal settlement. There have been four back-to-back deaths in October. Of the 10 infant deaths, six involved congenital anomalies, with heart defects among the commonly reported conditions. An expert committee of doctors and researchers is examining the deaths.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Ground Zero / Keralam / infants / health / government health care

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #27 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 In Keralam, the children beyond healthcare

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 01:36:34 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Attappady’s recurring infant deaths this year point to a crisis that goes beyond malnutrition and access to timely healthcare. Poverty, land alienation, and the erosion of traditional food systems, are taking a toll on maternal and child health in this predominantly tribal region of Keralam

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Between the pages of a logbook recording Dakshina’s treatment are ₹100, ₹50, ₹20, and ₹10 notes. Dakshina’s mother, Minnal Rani, had filed them away for her daughter’s medical expenses. The child is gone, but the money remains untouched. “We will never spend it,” she says, fighting back tears. Dakshina was five months old when doctors detected a hole in her heart. Born on June 13, 2025, she was taken to many hospitals, including one in Thiruvananthapuram, Keralam’s capital. With surgery ruled out, she was eventually referred to a cooperative hospital at Perinthalmanna, in Malappuram district, a two-and-a-half-hour drive away from home. She died here, on April 13, 2026. Rani and her husband Chandra Sekhar say the hospital refused to release their daughter’s body until they paid a bill of ₹10,000. They managed to raise the money with the help of a ward councillor. “We buried her under that tree,” says Rani, pointing to a coconut tree near their house at Vechapathi hamlet in Sholayur panchayat of Attappadi, Palakkad district. Dakshina’s death is among a series of 10 infant deaths reported this year from Attappadi, a predominantly tribal settlement. There have been four back-to-back deaths in October. Of the 10 infant deaths, six involved congenital anomalies, with heart defects among the commonly reported conditions. An expert committee of doctors and researchers is examining the deaths.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Ground Zero / Keralam / infants / health / government health care

articles.title: Koti Deepotsavam emerges as grand confluence of Shaiva, Vaishnava traditions in Telangana
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Bringing together revered spiritual heads, sacred rituals and devotees from across the State, the annual celebration offers a rare opportunity to experience diverse Hindu traditions at one venue, with the illumination of a crore earthen lamps forming its grand spectacle

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A confluence of Shaiva and Vaishnava traditions, a congregation of revered spiritual heads from across the country and the illumination of a crore lamps have made Koti Deepotsavam one of Telangana’s biggest religious celebrations outside temple premises. Held every year in Kartika month, the event draws thousands of devotees from different parts of the State, not merely to witness the ceremonies but also to participate in an array of rituals that are otherwise not easily accessible to the common devotee. Koti Deepotsavam offers devotees an opportunity to perform abhishekams, offer bilva leaves to Shiva Lingams, worship the Goddess and participate in special pujas and other ceremonies. The presence of Jagadgurus and heads of prominent peethams adds another dimension, enabling devotees to seek their blessings and have their darshan, an opportunity that many may seldom get otherwise. Over the past 13 years, Koti Deepotsavam has given a distinctive identity to the month of Kartika and to Telangana. The initiative began in 2012 as a Laksha Deepotsavam, or the lighting of one lakh lamps, and the following year evolved into Koti Deepotsavam, involving a crore lamps. The idea was conceived by Narendra Chowdary and his wife Ramadevi, and daughter Rachana, who run Bhakti TV. The genesis of the initiative lay in a visit by Sringeri Dakshinamnaya Peetham Jagadguru Sri Bharati Tirtha Mahaswami to Hyderabad during his Vijaya Yatra in 2012, when Kartika Deepotsavam was combined with the darshan of the Jagadguru for the Guru Vandanam. The first edition was organised at NTR Stadium, where a specially constructed stage depicting the grandeur of Kailasa provided the setting for the celebrations. The Sringeri Jagadguru performed Deeparadhana and blessed the devotees. By 2013, the Laksha Deepotsavam had grown into Koti Deepotsavam. What began as a single religious gathering gradually developed into an elaborate annual celebration, incorporating several traditions, rituals and cultural presentations. “The objective has been to recreate the experience of visiting important pilgrimage centres by bringing the deities and their traditions together at one venue,” says Mr. Narendra Chowdary.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: A distinctive feature is the presence of utsava murtis representing important temples and pilgrimage centres. Deities associated with the 12 Jyotirlingas, Pancha Bhuta Lingas, 18 Shakti Peethas and Divya Desams of the Sri Vaishnava tradition are brought to the venue and worshipped. Shaiva centres such as Ujjain, Arunachalam, Vemulawada and Kaleshwaram find representation alongside Vaishnava shrines such as Yadadri and Srirangam, and Shakti Peethas including Alampur, Kanchi and Varanasi.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #7 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Koti Deepotsavam emerges as grand confluence of Shaiva, Vaishnava traditions in Telangana

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 07:25:05 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Bringing together revered spiritual heads, sacred rituals and devotees from across the State, the annual celebration offers a rare opportunity to experience diverse Hindu traditions at one venue, with the illumination of a crore earthen lamps forming its grand spectacle

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A confluence of Shaiva and Vaishnava traditions, a congregation of revered spiritual heads from across the country and the illumination of a crore lamps have made Koti Deepotsavam one of Telangana’s biggest religious celebrations outside temple premises. Held every year in Kartika month, the event draws thousands of devotees from different parts of the State, not merely to witness the ceremonies but also to participate in an array of rituals that are otherwise not easily accessible to the common devotee. Koti Deepotsavam offers devotees an opportunity to perform abhishekams, offer bilva leaves to Shiva Lingams, worship the Goddess and participate in special pujas and other ceremonies. The presence of Jagadgurus and heads of prominent peethams adds another dimension, enabling devotees to seek their blessings and have their darshan, an opportunity that many may seldom get otherwise. Over the past 13 years, Koti Deepotsavam has given a distinctive identity to the month of Kartika and to Telangana. The initiative began in 2012 as a Laksha Deepotsavam, or the lighting of one lakh lamps, and the following year evolved into Koti Deepotsavam, involving a crore lamps. The idea was conceived by Narendra Chowdary and his wife Ramadevi, and daughter Rachana, who run Bhakti TV. The genesis of the initiative lay in a visit by Sringeri Dakshinamnaya Peetham Jagadguru Sri Bharati Tirtha Mahaswami to Hyderabad during his Vijaya Yatra in 2012, when Kartika Deepotsavam was combined with the darshan of the Jagadguru for the Guru Vandanam. The first edition was organised at NTR Stadium, where a specially constructed stage depicting the grandeur of Kailasa provided the setting for the celebrations. The Sringeri Jagadguru performed Deeparadhana and blessed the devotees. By 2013, the Laksha Deepotsavam had grown into Koti Deepotsavam. What began as a single religious gathering gradually developed into an elaborate annual celebration, incorporating several traditions, rituals and cultural presentations. “The objective has been to recreate the experience of visiting important pilgrimage centres by bringing the deities and their traditions together at one venue,” says Mr. Narendra Chowdary.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: A distinctive feature is the presence of utsava murtis representing important temples and pilgrimage centres. Deities associated with the 12 Jyotirlingas, Pancha Bhuta Lingas, 18 Shakti Peethas and Divya Desams of the Sri Vaishnava tradition are brought to the venue and worshipped. Shaiva centres such as Ujjain, Arunachalam, Vemulawada and Kaleshwaram find representation alongside Vaishnava shrines such as Yadadri and Srirangam, and Shakti Peethas including Alampur, Kanchi and Varanasi.

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Congregation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Celebration' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।

🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Koti Deepotsavam emerges as grand confluence of Shaiva, Vaishnava traditions in Telangana", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Bringing together revered spiritual heads, sacred rituals and devotees from across the State, the annual celebration offers a rare opportunity to...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Koti Deepotsavam emerges as grand confluence of ' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Koti Deepotsavam emerges as grand confluence ' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Koti Deepotsavam emerges as grand confluence ' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Bringing together revered spiritual heads, sacred rituals and devotees from across the State, the annual celebration offers a rare opportunity to..." (Hinglish Arth: राज्य भर से श्रद्धेय आध्यात्मिक प्रमुखों, पवित्र अनुष्ठानों और भक्तों को एक साथ लाते हुए, वार्षिक उत्सव रोशनी के साथ एक ही स्थान पर विविध हिंदू परंपराओं का अनुभव करने का एक दुर्लभ अवसर प्रदान करता है।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Koti Deepotsavam emerges as grand confluence of Shaiva, Vaishnava traditions in Telangana"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Shaiva centres such as Ujjain, Arunachalam, Vemulawada and Kaleshwaram find representation alongside Vaishnava shrines such as Yadadri and Srirangam,...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Shaiva centres such as Ujjain, Arunachalam, Vemulawada and Kaleshwaram find representation alongside Vaishnava shrines such as Yadadri and Srirangam,..." (Hinglish Arth: उज्जैन, अरुणाचलम, वेमुलावाड़ा और कालेश्वरम जैसे शैव केंद्रों को यदाद्रि और श्रीरंगम जैसे वैष्णव मंदिरों और आलमपुर, कांची और वाराणसी सहित शक्ति पीठों के साथ प्रतिनिधित्व मिलता है।)

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Scientists indicate that the ongoing strong El Niño could persist until March 2027, followed by neutral conditions and a possible transition to La Niña during the Southwest Monsoon. They are also monitoring widespread marine heatwaves across the Indian Ocean

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: While the powerful El Niño continues to strengthen over the Pacific Ocean, scientists are beginning to see signs that its cooler counterpart, La Niña, could emerge by the time the Southwest Monsoon arrives in 2027.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Scientists at the Hyderabad-based Indian National Centre for Ocean Information Services (INCOIS) say the ongoing El Niño is likely to remain dominant until March next year. But, climate models indicate a gradual transition to neutral conditions thereafter, followed by increasing chances of La Niña development during the 2027 Southwest monsoon season.

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Odisha Chief Minister said heavy rainfall was expected in Mayurbhanj and Balasore over the next 24 hours, with its impact likely to extend to neighbouring Jajpur, Bhadrak, Kendrapara and Jagatsinghpur districts

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu sought central assistance of nearly ₹100 crore for the restoration of horticultural crops damaged by cyclones Arnab and Murasu. “Naidu has written a letter to Union Minister for Agriculture and Farmers Welfare Shivraj Singh Chouhan, seeking additional financial assistance for the restoration of horticulture crops damaged by two consecutive cyclones,” a press release said. The cyclones damaged crops across 29,960 hectares in 18 districts, affecting 71,576 farmers and causing losses estimated at ₹1,092 crore, he said. The cyclone had considerably lost its intensity when it made landfall near Gopalpur in Odisha. “The cyclonic storm Akvan crossed the south coastal Odisha and north Andhra Pradesh close to Gopalpur with a wind speed of 70-80 kmph, gusting to 90 kmph during 7.30 a.m. to 8.30 a.m.,” said the India Meteorological Department (IMD). Landfall of Cyclone Akvan nears Odisha and Andhra Pradesh coasts as land interaction begins, with heavy rainfall and prolonged impact anticipated. The depression is likely to move nearly northwards over Odisha and weaken further into a low-pressure area during next 6 hours, said IMD

Landfall of Cyclone Akvan nears Odisha and Andhra Pradesh coasts as land interaction begins, with heavy rainfall and prolonged impact anticipated. articles.title: India says no change in its position on Indus Water Treaty as Pakistan minister attends SCO forum in Delhi
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: India suspended the treaty in 2025 as one of the punitive measures against Pakistan after the April 22 Pahalgam terror attack last year that claimed 26 lives

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: India's position on the Indus Waters Treaty (IWT) is "very clear" and there has been "absolutely no change" in it, the Ministry of External Affairs said on Friday (November 20, 2026), amid a visit by Pakistan Minister Musadik Malik to attend the SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum in Delhi. Mr. Malik, who arrived here in the early hours of Friday (November 20, 2026), attended the opening day of the three-day forum in the evening. The event, being hosted by India at the historic Purana Quila, was inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi. India had announced on October 28 that invitations had been extended to all SCO members, including Pakistan, in keeping with established practice. It was perhaps the first time New Delhi had invited a Pakistani minister to attend an event in India since the May 7-10 military hostilities last year following Operation Sindoor. Pakistan had announced on November 14 that its Climate Change Minister Malik would participate in the forum. "As far as IWT is concerned, we have made our position very clear, and that is where it remains. There is absolutely no change," Mr. Jaiswal said. India suspended the treaty in 2025 as one of the punitive measures against Pakistan after the April 22 Pahalgam terror attack last year that claimed 26 lives. Mr. Malik's participation in the forum is being seen by some experts as an opportunity in a multilateral framework that may help improve ties between the two neighbours. Interacting with reporters on the sidelines of the forum, Mr. Malik, when asked about the role of culture in fostering better ties between India and Pakistan, said, "Culture has a very key role to play".

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Hours before the inauguration, the MEA on Friday (November 20, 2026) said the forum was a "multilateral event within the SCO framework", for which invitations had been extended to all members of the grouping, including Pakistan.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #10 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 India says no change in its position on Indus Water Treaty as Pakistan minister attends SCO forum in Delhi

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 06:56:57 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: India suspended the treaty in 2025 as one of the punitive measures against Pakistan after the April 22 Pahalgam terror attack last year that claimed 26 lives

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: India's position on the Indus Waters Treaty (IWT) is "very clear" and there has been "absolutely no change" in it, the Ministry of External Affairs said on Friday (November 20, 2026), amid a visit by Pakistan Minister Musadik Malik to attend the SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum in Delhi. Mr. Malik, who arrived here in the early hours of Friday (November 20, 2026), attended the opening day of the three-day forum in the evening. The event, being hosted by India at the historic Purana Quila, was inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi. India had announced on October 28 that invitations had been extended to all SCO members, including Pakistan, in keeping with established practice. It was perhaps the first time New Delhi had invited a Pakistani minister to attend an event in India since the May 7-10 military hostilities last year following Operation Sindoor. Pakistan had announced on November 14 that its Climate Change Minister Malik would participate in the forum. "As far as IWT is concerned, we have made our position very clear, and that is where it remains. There is absolutely no change," Mr. Jaiswal said. India suspended the treaty in 2025 as one of the punitive measures against Pakistan after the April 22 Pahalgam terror attack last year that claimed 26 lives. Mr. Malik's participation in the forum is being seen by some experts as an opportunity in a multilateral framework that may help improve ties between the two neighbours. Interacting with reporters on the sidelines of the forum, Mr. Malik, when asked about the role of culture in fostering better ties between India and Pakistan, said, "Culture has a very key role to play".

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Hours before the inauguration, the MEA on Friday (November 20, 2026) said the forum was a "multilateral event within the SCO framework", for which invitations had been extended to all members of the grouping, including Pakistan.

बहुपक्षीय — जिसमें दो से अधिक देश (जैसे UN, G20, BRICS) मिलकर साझा फैसला लेते हैं।

Civilisational (Adjective)

Participation (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Participation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Inauguration (Adjective / Verb)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Inauguration' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable

Peace has been an enduring pursuit of humanity. Our planet has been put through more than 10,000 wars,” the host, Mr. Xi said, calling the trilateral summit a “groundbreaking move”. India is not a member of the 21-nation APEC grouping, and Prime Minister Narendra Modi had met Mr. Trump on Tuesday (November 17, 2026) at the Quad summit in Manila. “There were some concrete outcomes which came out of [the Quad Summit] including the Quad Business Leaders Forum which is to be held next year,” Mr. Jaiswal said, listing initiatives announced after the Quad meeting, including on emerging technologies, maritime surveillance, cybersecurity cooperation and security issues. “These decisions are [examples of] practical cooperation that is delivering for the people and countries in the Indo-Pacific region,” Mr. Jaiswal added.
